Embark on a journey through the human psyche and experience six atmospheric and thought-provoking chapters, each symbolising a different aspect or challenge associated with mental health issues; from isolation to anxiety, with everyday situations being distorted beyond recognition. Raw, emotive and earnest, Fractured Minds demonstrates that video games are capable of communicating vital messages in imaginative ways. games.summary: Feel Good Post-apo simulator of cleaning up and repairing a fallen world in single-player FPS mode. Clean polluted environment, repair, renovate and turn on objects long forgotten by time. Make new friends, take care of nature or even plant a forest. Give these places a Fresh Start!

games.name: Freshly Frosted
games.summary: Place conveyor belts to solve puzzles in the world's most adorable donut factory!
games.storyline: A dozen dozen dazzling donut dilemmas await you, that's 144 puzzles to please your particular puzzley passions. To excite and delight there are mechanics galore; from splitters to pushers, mergers and cloners, randomizers, teleporters, and more! What's your favorite donut? Sweet and sprinkled... a jolly jelly-filled... perhaps a marvelous maple bar? What about one shaped like a pumpkin, a snowflake, or a star! Discover many a whimsical shape as you explore a sweet skyscape of pastry possibilities. Journey through this sweet sensation accompanied by soothing narration. A calming voice over focused on positivity guides you through each puzzle with assuring affability. With pleasant pastels and mesmerizing machines the satisfying scenes will catch your eyes and mesmerize! Each of a dozen donut boxes brings its own fetching flavor; a taste of autumn, a sip of summer, a whisper of winter. Days in the sun. Nights under the moon. And each world with its own special tune. The lullabies of these pastel skies are all unique and each reaches its peak when you find your way and set your factory to play!

games.name: Freud's Bones: The Game
games.summary: Freud's Bones is the first point&click narrative-driven game to pay homage to the birth of psychoanalysis and its founder, addressing the themes of sexuality and neuroses filled with existential doubts.
games.storyline: Vienna, 1925. The night drips on the windows of a barely-lit studio. A man walks nervously on the dusty Persian carpet, gripped by a confused monologue and wrapped up in the dense fumes of his beloved cigar. The critics are tearing him down on the newspapers, his family relationships are tense, there are instincts to keep at bay and then some cryptic anonymous letters were sent in... enough reasons to be insomniac! Sigmund Freud, torn by doubts about his work and his future, is about to be get shoked. A voice breaks his thoughts, tearing the silence. That voice belongs to his demon: YOU.

games.name: Friday the 13th: Killer Puzzle
games.summary: "From the makers of Slayaway Camp—the award-winning “Bloodiest Puzzle Game Ever”—comes an even more frightening puzzler starring one of horror’s most iconic killers. Now you can go behind the hockey mask of Jason Voorhees on his mission to murder unfortunate campers at Crystal Lake and beyond. Players control Jason by sliding him around an isometric puzzle level to attack his victims, either directly with a variety of weapons, or indirectly, by frightening them into environmental hazards like campfires, bear traps, and woodchippers. Gruesome reflex-based “Kill Scenes” punctuate the puzzling as you progress through multiple episodes, from classic campgrounds to more exotic locations such as Manhattan, abandoned amusement parks, supermax prisons, beach resorts, outer space and more."

games.name: Friday the 13th: The Game
games.summary: Friday the 13th: The Game is a third-person horror, survival game where players take on the role of a teen counselor, or for the first time ever, Jason Voorhees. You and six other unlucky souls will do everything possible to escape and survive while the most well-known killer in the world tracks you down and brutally slaughters you.

games.name: Friday the 13th: The Game - Ultimate Slasher Edition
games.summary: For the first time ever, you will have the opportunity to play as Jason Voorhees, the most famous killer in horror. Stalk your prey, ambush them whenever you see fit and strike fear in the hearts of so many hapless victims as you become the legend himself! Friday the 13th: The Game will include a variety of kills, new and familiar, that will help you set the tone for the Jason Voorhees that you want to be. You’ll even get to unlock various Jason incarnations from the movies! Jason will be equipped with a terrifying array of abilities, giving you the control of a hunter at the height of his game. These are his woods, and he knows them all too well. Jason will not only feed off the fear of his victims, but will become stronger as the night progresses. The darker the night, the more terrifying Jason becomes!

games.name: Fridge Escape
games.summary: Don't let anyone eat you. Run to save your life!

games.name: Frido
games.summary: Robot time traveler got into the past. To get out, he needs to get to the time machine, passing more than 10 exciting levels.

games.name: Frightence
games.summary: Frighthence is a short, intense first-person horror experience. You are the janitor who works at the infamous Apartment #17, which is the seed of many eeire tales and bloodcurdling urban legends... The apartment recently got an eviction notice and tonight, you must check every resident’s flat to make sure that everybody has left. Soon you will realize that things are not the way they seem in this dreadful apartment…

games.name: Frodoric the Driver
games.summary: Frodoric is a Belgian shepherd who has run out of his favorite cigarettes. Due to the regulations set by the government and national health care, the Tobacco Store is far away and requires him to embark on a journey through hundreds of locations. Hop in the car with your best friend Furcat (persian cat) and drive! Key features: - Drive through dozens of unique locations and regions! - Slam other cars to score points! - Use many types of weapons to break through the obstacles on the road! - Collect points and buy new vehicles! - Fantastic music that will help you relax for many hours! ‚Äì Dynamic weather and procedural difficulty system! - Fantastic retro-like visual style!

games.name: Frog Ball Rerolled
games.summary: Collect pineapples as you roll your way to victory in Frog Ball Rerolled! Frog Ball Rerolled is a deluxe version of Frog Ball, a marble-rolling game with charming characters and precise controls. With over 35 full levels and over 1,400+ customization options, you'll never get bored!

games.name: Frog Detective 1: The Haunted Island
games.summary: A small sloth has been haunted for weeks by a mysterious ghost that nobody can seem to track down. There's a mystery afoot, and the only one who can solve it is the renowned investigator known simply as The Detective. Finding clues and questioning suspects is just part of the job for such an experienced frog, but this case is a tough fly to catch.
games.storyline: There's something fishy going on here... Is this island REALLY haunted or is there something even MORE sinister afoot? Or something even LESS sinister? Find out in the newest (and currently the only) adventure in the Frog Detective series! Play as the freshest frog in the pond and find the secret of The Haunted Island. Using your extreme investigation skills, question suspects and find clues to get to the bottom of this spooky and mysterious mystery.

games.name: Frog Detective 2: The Case of the Invisible Wizard
games.summary: The famed Frog Detective returns in the most thrilling mystery yet! A town’s welcoming celebration for a mysterious Invisible Wizard has been ripped to shreds by an unknown culprit. The Detective must find out “whodunnit”! The Case of the Invisible Wizard is the second game in the Frog Detective series, following The Haunted Island, which was loved by all.* *(Except for one user on Steam who called it “a middle finger and a waste of $5”, but we can’t win em all.)

games.name: Frog Detective 3: Corruption at Cowboy County
games.summary: In the exciting series finale, The Detective and Lobster Cop are tasked to solve the conundrum of a sheriff-less county. But not all is as it seems here, when a surprisingly simple solution to the case reveals a sinister scheme. Maybe crime is real after all...
games.storyline: In the exciting series finale, The Detective and Lobster Cop are tasked to solve the conundrum of a sheriff-less county. But not all is as it seems here, when a surprisingly simple solution to the case reveals a sinister scheme. Maybe crime is real after all... Corruption at Cowboy County is the third and final game in the Frog Detective series. Frog Detective 3: Corruption at Cowboy County is a family-friendly yet witty take on the detective game genre. Solve the mysteries on your own, or play along with friends as you take turns reading out the dialogue. Think you can crack the case?

games.name: Frog Hop
games.summary: A cute and quirky old-school adventure platformer about a Frog named Hoppy searching for his frog friend Jumpy. Features a large variety of gimmicks, enemies, obstacles. Unique and challenging boss fights. Equip charms to alter your play style. It has hats.

games.name: Frog in the Fog
games.summary: Croak from the Fog

games.name: Frog Legs
games.summary: A short, single-player horror action game starring Carl, the suburban house frog. Will you be able to conquer arcade challenges, solve puzzles, and Ribbit and Tear your way back to the life you once knew?

games.name: Frog Parkour Obby
games.summary: Hop, jump, and dodge your way through every level!

games.name: Frogborne
games.summary: A long way from the pond — but home is worth the leap.

games.name: Frogborne: New Lands
games.summary: A colorful adventure awaits!

games.name: Froggie: A Retro Platformer
games.summary: Froggie is a platform game with retro graphics

games.name: Frogging Up
games.summary: Frogging Up is a punishing yet rewarding physics platformer about a small frog in a yellow raincoat who dreams of escaping his muddy village life. Guided only by determination (and a very questionable sense of balance), he begins an impossible climb through a surreal world of floating pipes, platforms, and mechanical ruins. Each jump is a step closer to the top and a better life.
games.storyline: A small frog in a yellow raincoat dreams of escaping his muddy village and finding a better life. To achieve this, he begins a difficult climb through a surreal world of floating pipes, platforms, and mechanical ruins. As he rises from the swamps toward the shimmering towers above, his journey becomes a story about struggle, ambition, failure, and determination.

games.name: Froggonit
games.summary: Froggonit is a cute comedy adventure about a frog with an obsession for secrets. Collect cards, defeat your enemies in turn-based battles and try to restore light to the island.

games.name: Froggy Bouncing Adventures
games.summary: Jump into a bouncing adventure to save Froggy’s best friend! 60 levels of leapfrogging platforming and hat collection!

games.name: Froggy Brews
games.summary: Froggy Brews is a cozy narrative adventure, where every cup of tea tells a story. Play as a tea-loving frog returning to your old neighborhood that has changed over time. Brew tea for villagers, uncover heartfelt stories, and rediscover your place in this world.

games.name: Froggy Crossing
games.summary: Help Froggy the frog fill his belly with yummy coins! But be carrefull, you'll have to cross roads full of danger... Get new characters to play with using your collected coins. Have fun!

games.name: Froggy Hates Snow
games.summary: A survival roguelike where a frog digs through freezing snow, uncovers treasures, unlocks upgrades, and battles mystical creatures. Find the escape door or defeat the final boss to survive.

games.name: Frogo Deluxe
games.summary: Frogo Deluxe is the latest installment in the popular Frogo series. In this cross road game, players must navigate through various obstacles, collecting coins and special items along the way. The coins collected can be used to purchase new animals, each with more lives, enhancing the gameplay experience. The game is infinite, becoming more challenging as players achieve higher scores. How far can you go?

games.name: Frogs vs. Storks
games.summary: In Frogs vs. Storks you play with your little frogs that make a good and peaceful living in their beautiful pond. But, with the arrival of storks, the pond became a dangerous place to live! Storks are everywhere now just waiting for their chance to eat your frogs! Outsmart evil storks and once again make you pond a peaceful place to live in Frogs vs. Storks.

games.name: Frogsong
games.summary: Frogsong is a heartfelt adventure where it's okay to be small. You'll make new friends, explore beautiful environments, and embark on a journey to find your place in the world.
games.storyline: Chorus is a little frog with huge dreams of protecting the world. Being a tree frog, however, society expects them to lead a life of religious studies, instead of training to be a warrior. Their small size certainly doesn't help anyone take them seriously, either. Seeking a better life, Chorus moves to Boreala, a village where members of the Defense Guild train under the wisdom of an old veteran. They quickly learn things aren't going to be as easy as they hoped. With a powerful army and a mysterious rumour both on the rise, Chorus needs to discover how they can protect the ones they love - before it's too late.

games.name: Frogue
games.summary: Embark in a journey to rescue your dog in Frogue. A bullet-hell time manipulation roguelike platformer.

games.name: Frogun
games.summary: Join Renata as she adventures across a world of mystical ruins with the titular FROGUN! Frogun is an old-school platformer with the soul of the PS1/N64 era, in which your frog-shaped grappling hook is a your best friend!
games.storyline: Renata's parents are world-renown explorers, archeologists and inventors that travel all over the world uncovering the secrets of the past, bringing her with them in their expeditions. However, in their latest adventure, they decide to leave her at the base camp - the Beelzebub ruins are said to be too dangerous! For three whole days she waits, her pride hurt and bored out of her mind, until she realized: if they haven't returned yet, something must have happened to them! In a hurry she grabs her parents' last invention, the Frogun, and heads to the ruins to rescue them, and prove that she's as capable as them!

games.name: Frogun Encore
games.summary: Frogun Encore is a dashing standalone expansion/sequel to indie hit Frogun! Join now older Renata and Jake in a trek around the whole world to prevent the return of Beelzebub. Encore builds on Frogun's retro PS1/N64 formula. Plus, enjoy the whole adventure in true couch co-op.
games.storyline: Three whole years have passed since Renata defeated Beelzebub, and her small vacation in Jake's town is cut short when the fly bois attack again! It seems one of Beelzebub's loyal followers has an evil scheme in motion to bring him back, and Renata, Jake and Hatter will have to travel the whole world to foil his plans.

games.name: Frogun: Deluxe Edition
games.summary: Deluxe Edition features: The deluxe edition of Frogun features a slew of exclusive, bonus digital goodies! - A 50 Page, Hi-Res Digital Artbook featuring concept art, behind the scenes concepts and 3D models, environment and promotional art, and more! - A 12 Page Retro-Style Digital Manual, with bonus art, lore, and tips & tricks! - A Dedicated Music Listening Room, for revisiting and replaying all 21 music tracks from the game's original soundtrack!

games.name: Frogurai
games.summary: Welcome to Japan in the feudal age, in the midst of samurais, your role as a frog is to cut all the snakurais to save the frogurai kingdom and end the war between frogs and snakes.

games.name: Frogvival
games.summary: You are what you eat indeed and in Frogvival you can really experience that assessment. Frogvival is a survival game where you can devour animals to mutate into them!

games.name: From Cheese
games.summary: Twist your mind, challenge your skills, get the Cheese!

games.name: From Earth to Heaven
games.summary: In this game, you follow the protagonist who initially fell from heaven back into the sky. The game is a unique combination of a first-person platformer and a light-hearted exploration game with an almost philosophical story-telling. It is highly stylized and surprises with breathtaking environments, a surreal world full of beauty and grace, and a couple of small environmental puzzles that blend perfectly into the peaceful yet stunning environments. Will you be able to make it back into heaven? Find it out.

games.name: From Heaven to Earth
games.summary: Find your way down to earth in this amazing platformer game

games.name: From Madness with Love
games.summary: This is a dating sim with guys you will never be on the same page with! For some reason, you just can't communicate with the guy you like... An unusual yet extraordinary experience with a cute pixel art style, fully voiced in Japanese.
games.storyline: You are the main character, a simple high school sophomore. However, last year your high school was bombed by terrorists, so you were transferred to the closest school to your home—a private school for rich kids.

games.name: From Orbit
games.summary: From Orbit is a quick and light single player Action RTS. Guide your stranded crew home as they land on alien planets, scout out the area, build defenses, harvest valuable resources, and launch back into orbit before being overwhelmed by hostile aliens.

games.name: From Shadows
games.summary: What a filth enveloped the world that its only salvation may be… two bloody beasts? Born of anger, blood and night werewolf Gregor and vampire Hredrick launch a crusade in defiance of unspeakable evil. Will they accomplish the mission even though opposed by hordes of hellish opponents, enraged people they are trying to save and even ... your loved ones? There are no illusions. This time the stakes are the highest possible.

games.name: From Shadows
games.summary: From Shadows is an action game blending the style of fast-paced platformers and beat’em ups. The menacing gothic atmosphere and foreboding music build tension, while the hand-drawn graphics give shape to unimaginable horrors straight from hell. This indie title offers options for solo play as well as cooperative split-screen and lets you publish your scores on global leaderboards. Unleash your inner beast and step out of the shadows!

games.name: From Space
games.summary: From Space is a solo and co-op action-shooter for squads up to four players. Take on the challenge of liberating the earth from an alien infestation with your friends, using over-the-top weaponry in a post-apocalyptic world with awesomely stylized graphics. The apocalypse has never been so much fun!

games.name: From Space: Resistance Bundle
games.summary: From Space is a solo and co-op action-shooter for squads up to four players. Take on the challenge of liberating the earth from an alien infestation with your friends, using over-the-top weaponry in a post-apolcayptic world with awesomely stylized graphics. The apocalypse has never been so much fun!

games.name: From The Bunker
games.summary: You are trapped in a crumbling, post-apocalyptic bunker, and your only goal is survival. Navigate dark corridors, smash obstacles with your trusty hammer, and find hidden paths as you search for an exit. Each level increases the difficulty with destructible doors, furniture, and secret rooms that test your wit, timing, and strategy.

games.name: From_.
games.summary: Mr. Postman sails his small boat through watery Aquaria, delivering letters day in and day out. One day, he awakes to find something strange and unbelievable following him, just as a dark rumor begins to spread through Aquaria. As the letters he delivers bring writer and reader together, the truth begins to come into focus.

games.name: Front Mission 1st: Remake
games.summary: Wanzers return to the battlefield once more! Prepare for battle with Front Mission 1st: Remake, a remake of the sci-fi turn-based strategy game Front Mission 1st.
games.storyline: In the year 2090, the world's conflicts are fought using giant war machines called Wanzers. Huffman Island, the only place where the Oceania Cooperative Union (O.C.U.) and the Unified Continental States (U.C.S.) share a land border is a hotbed of conflict. An O.C.U. reconnaissance platoon led by Captain Royd Clive is assigned to investigate a U.C.S. munitions plant. They are ambushed by U.C.S. Wanzers, triggering a series of events that plunges the whole island into war. Royd's fiancée, Lieutenant Karen Meure, goes missing in action. Discharged from the military, Royd sets out to investigate what happened to Karen. His quest leads him closer and closer to the conspiracy behind the incident and the powers that orchestrated it. With dozens of characters to meet, its mature story, and non-Manichean protagonists, Front Mission is the classic of a tactical Japanese RPG genre, finally available worldwide.

games.name: Front Mission 2: Remake
games.summary: Front Mission 2: Remake is a remake of the sci-fi tactical role-playing game Front Mission 2. The Remake preserves the mature story, strategic turn-based combat, and Wanzer customization options of the original. Enjoy the revitalized classic with updated visuals and new features and enhancements!
games.storyline: Set in the year 2102, twelve years after the events of the first Front Mission, the story takes place in Alordesh, a member state of the Oceania Cooperative Union simmering with anti-OCU resentment. When the Alordeshi military stages a sudden coup and declares independence, its forces overrun the local OCU garrisons and plunge the country into chaos. The tale follows three individuals caught in the uprising, corporal Ash Faruk, captain Thomas Norland, and intelligence officer Lisa Stanley, whose separate struggles to survive, rescue prisoners, and fight back gradually intertwine as they uncover the hidden powers backing the coup and pilot the mechanized war machines known as wanzers.

games.name: Front Mission 3: Remake
games.summary: Front Mission 3: Remake is the third chapter in the iconic series beloved by fans worldwide. Step into the role of Kazuki and Ryogo as tensions rise across volatile military zones. With the fate of the region hanging in the balance, command towering Wanzers and lead your squad through intense, turn-based battles.

games.name: Front Mission: 1st Remake - Limited Edition
games.summary: The Front Mission 1st Limited Edition includes: - The base game - 2 lithographs - An exclusive lenticular box - A printed game manual

games.name: Frontier Quest
games.summary: Rebuild a frontier town and become acquainted with its community in puzzle-RPG Frontier Quest! Explore the frontier, collect materials and defeat monsters with the right equipment and in order to restore the town and uncover the secrets of the frontier.
games.storyline: A young adventurer journeys out into the frontier in search of legendary artifacts, however they quickly find their path blocked by the various monsters living there. To make matters worse the frontier town is in no shape to provide support, so our adventurer ends up helping repair the town in exchange for better equipment to take on the frontier.

games.name: Frontline Zed
games.summary: n the midst of a zombie outbreak, defend your fortified barricade by night, and collect weapons and conduct repairs by day. Survive long enough to make your way through America and towards rescue.
games.storyline: All that separates you from the horde is a wall… built yourself, from scrap. Collect weapons where you can. Manage your time well. Will you spend precious daylight hours repairing your defense, or searching for other survivors to help you fight? The promise of rescue beckons - if you can survive long enough to make it.

games.name: Frost
games.summary: Frost is a Survival solo Card game. Inspired by deck-building board games like Dominion, Ascension and the like, it's an unique take on the genre as it puts you in charge of a group of people struggling against a restless, lethal storm.

games.name: Frost Station
games.summary: Explore the frozen planet!

games.name: Frost Survival: Winter
games.summary: The wind howls across the frozen mountains. Snow stretches endlessly to the horizon, and the cold cuts deeper with every step. In Frost Survival – Winter, you are alone in a merciless wilderness where nature shows no mercy and survival is never guaranteed.

games.name: Frost Vale
games.summary: Step into the cold. Explore the unknown.

games.name: Frostholm Isle
games.summary: A Quiet Northern Journey

games.name: Frosty Jump
games.summary: Join Frosty on his quest and meet all his new snow friends! Play as Mrs. Frosty, Space Frosty and Cowboy Frosty! Collect over 50 additional Frosty friends! Avoid enemies and use your power-ups as you jump along this snowy endless jumping adventure! • Help Frosty jump through endless frozen levels! • Over 50 different playable snow friends to collect! • Awesome power-ups to help Frosty escape! • Perfect for endless year-round fun!

games.name: Frowntown
games.summary: So you've decided to become a stand-up comedian?

games.name: Frozen Friends
games.summary: Join the Ice Queen and her Frozen Friends in this endless jumping adventure! Help the Ice Queen escape the frozen forest and make it back to the kingdom all while avoiding evil monsters along the way! Collect coins and use them to open up MAGIC treasure chests filled with more Frozen Friends tocollect and play with! Play as Black Beard, Greta Goblin and MANY, MANY MORE! Also use your coins to buy POWERUPS to last longer in this endless frozen adventure! Magical powerups like the invincibility shield will help you avoid enemies and reach high scores!

games.name: Frozen Honey ASMR
games.summary: Enjoy making your frozen honey jelly desserts from scratch in the most satisfying ASMR game!

games.name: Fruit Attack!!
games.summary: Merge the funny fruits and get the giant cherry!

games.name: Fruit Fall Crush
games.summary: A puzzle game.

games.name: Fruit Mountain
games.summary: Fruit Mountain is a 3D physics puzzle game where you stack fruits. Combine fruits of the same kind to make them bigger and bigger! Stack them up without overflowing the plate and create your own Fruit Mountain!

games.name: Fruit Mountain Party
games.summary: A brand new game in the hit 3D puzzle game "Fruit Mountain" where you combine fruits to make them bigger is finally here! This time, it's fruit battles!? There are plenty of versus modes that everyone can enjoy! Get together for online or local multiplayer! Keep stacking those fruits!

games.name: Fruit Party: Suika Casual Puzzle
games.summary: A fun and challenging match puzzle game where you have to match colorful fruits to make them bigger!

games.name: Fruitbus
games.summary: Fruitbus is a cute culinary adventure, set in an open world where taste is everything. Upgrade your trusty truck and visit a whole world of new destinations together.

games.name: FruitFall Crush
games.summary: FruitFall Crush, a true puzzle game, ideally suited to the Nintendo Switch gaming philosophy.

games.name: Fruits Slot Machine
games.summary: Spin the reels and win multiple payouts and a legendary jackpot.

games.name: Fruity Puzzler
games.summary: Welcome to the juicy world of Fruity Puzzler, where vibrant colors and brain-teasing challenges collide! Dive into a refreshing gaming experience that will tantalize your senses and stimulate your mind.

games.name: Frutakia 2
games.summary: Frutakia by CrazySoft is back and better than ever! Make groups of 3 or more same fruits/items in any direction! Sounds simple? Its not!

games.name: Fuel Station Simulator
games.summary: Transform an abandoned fuel station into a thriving business hub! Manage, customise, and expand your empire!

games.name: Fueled Up
games.summary: Fueled Up is a chaotic couch co-op spaceship recovery game for up to four players. You and your crewmates must fuel, fix and rescue damaged spaceships before the evil space octopus gets its tentacles on them!
games.storyline: Return the spaceships to safety while dealing with unexpected dangers like wormholes, asteroid showers, and space squids. Keep the engines fueled up, fix hull breaches, and extinguish fires or risk the ship blowing up! There are no boring days in the life of a spaceship recovery engineer!

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel
games.summary: Fuga is set in a war-ravaged world where a village is destroyed by the fascist Berman Empire. Eleven child survivors band together after the attack and board a gigantic tank known as Taranis - a relic of an ancient but technologically-advanced civilization - in order to travel across the dangerous landscape and rescue their families who were taken prisoner. The Taranis houses a super weapon called the Soul Cannon which is capable of immense destruction at the cost of a crew member's life, with the main characters having to choose when and whom to sacrifice in order for the group to reach their destination.

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel - Deluxe Edition
games.summary: "We have to fight! If we don't, everyone we love will be taken away!" One fateful night, a peaceful village is thrown into the flames of war. Determined to save their families, a group of children boards a giant tank and begins an offensive charge! Fuga: Melodies of Steel is an RPG where you place children, each with their own unique characteristics and skills, at different gun turrets in a tank to fight against the enemy. Living inside the tank, the children show emotion and gain affinity amongst each other. Manage these both to change the outcome of their journey!

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2
games.summary: The sequel to the captivating tale of Fuga: Melodies of Steel has arrived! This turn-based RPG is back with a ramped up battle system for more strategy, as well as a brand new event system that gives you more thrilling choices to affect your experience!
games.storyline: Set a year after the events of the first game, in a world of anthropomorphic dogs and cats modeled on World War II-era France, the bloody war between rival nations has finally ended and the group of children who once fought in it have returned to peaceful lives. That peace is shattered when their old giant tank, the Taranis, mysteriously roars back to life on its own, going on a rampage and abducting some of the friends. Led by the young Malt Marzipan and joined by a new ally named Vanilla, the remaining children climb aboard another colossal war machine, the Tarascus, and set off to rescue their captured companions.

games.storyline: Set a year after the events of the first game, in a world of anthropomorphic dogs and cats modeled on World War II-era France, the bloody war between rival nations has finally ended and the group of children who once fought in it have returned to peaceful lives. That peace is shattered when their old giant tank, the Taranis, mysteriously roars back to life on its own, going on a rampage and abducting some of the friends. Led by the young Malt Marzipan and joined by a new ally named Vanilla, the remaining children climb aboard another colossal war machine, the Tarascus, and set off to rescue their captured companions.

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3
games.summary: The Fuga: Melodies of Steel series has reached its epic conclusion! Dive into this dramatic RPG featuring a brand-new, strategic battle system, enhanced Taranis training during intermission, and tactical route progression and event battles!

games.name: Fukakutei Sekai no Tantei Shinshi: Akugyou Futaasa no Jiken File
games.summary: Port of Fukakutei Sekai no Tantei Shinshi, heavily censored from the PC release and new content.

games.name: Full Colour Tiles
games.summary: Fiendishly simple puzzle game

games.name: Full Metal Furies
games.summary: Defend the free world from tyrannical titans in FULL METAL FURIES – a team-based brawler where cooperation is the key to victory. An abstruse allegorical action adventure about atonement, allusions, and alliteration awaits all at an alternate age around Athens’ ashes. FULL METAL FURIES will challenge you to think like a team, and to rethink what a brawler could be.

games.name: Full Metal Schoolgirl
games.summary: In the year 2089, the United Federation of Japan is an industrial powerhouse, while also being one of the world’s leading countries in overtime work. In this sickening future, the economy is booming and working 24 hours a day is considered virtuous. The core of this country’s industry, economy, and social system are controlled by a single giant corporation. The rampage of a fully mechanized schoolgirl—a fully armed cyborg heroine storms into a giant corporation and unleashes a relentless barrage of gunfire and sword action in this exhilarating cyborg schoolgirl action adventure. The feeling of immorality is irresistible when you break into an office and wreak havoc.

games.name: Full Metal Schoolgirl: Deluxe Edition
games.summary: The "FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL" Deluxe Edition is a deluxe package that includes the main game bundled with additional DLC coming after the game is released. --Deluxe Edition Early Purchase Bonus Content-- -Additional Costume: Ryoko Costume: Aya's Battle Suit from "OneeChanbara ORIGIN" -Additional Costume: Akemi Costume: Saki's Battle Suit from "OneeChanbara ORIGIN" *Only for those who purchase from the PS Store by 3/31/2026 11:59pm. --Deluxe Edition Contents-- 1. "FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL" Main Game 2. "FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL" Season Pass --Season Pass Contents-- 1) Accessory: "Dopey Panda" in 2 Color Varieties 2) Accessory: "Victory Daruma" in 2 Color Varieties 3) Accessory: "Grey Alien" in 2 Color Varieties 4) Accessory: "Cat Tail" in 2 Color Varieties 5) Accessory: "Raccoon Tail" in 2 Color Varieties 6) Accessory: "Fox Tail" in 2 Color Varieties 7) Other 8 additional costumes 8) New Feature

games.name: Full Metal Sergeant
games.summary: You are a drill instructor, you have 12 weeks to turn a herd of dumb conscripts into war machines. Set their planning, upgrade your bootcamp and make sure the recruits don't kill themselves. Sir, Yes Sir!

games.name: Full of Crap
games.summary: Full of Crap is a card game. This game is a game of eating curry without poop while avoiding curry with poop. You watch their behavior carefully and eat a lot of curry without poop.

games.name: Full Quiet
games.summary: A totally new 8-Bit experience of survival, puzzles and exploration unlike anything you've played before.

games.name: Full Speed Animals: The RTA
games.summary: Let's escape from this planet by car? Fly in the sky with a sparrow? Can you run with a cheetah? Or... Customize your character by entering the pit during the game!

games.name: Full Void
games.summary: Set in a dystopian future, Full Void is a 2D cinematic puzzle platformer telling the story of a young teenager alone in a hostile world controlled by a rogue artificial intelligence. Fight your way through puzzles and obstacles to uncover the story that surrounds this broken, crumbling society where only children are still free. But for how long? A pure hand-drawn pixel-art adventure that will keep you on your toes from the very beginning, with a few jump-scares and a thrilling atmosphere but still suitable for all ages as it does not feature any gore or violence. Full Void is a spiritual successor to classic cinematic puzzle platformers such as Prince of Persia, Another World (Out of This World) and Flashback, with a modern twist, innovative visual and gameplay mechanics. Along with traditional puzzles, you can use your hacking skills to interact with elements of the game and make your way through this hostile world full of implacable, faceless creatures continuously one step behind you.

games.name: FullBlast
games.summary: Blast your way through waves of alien invaders in this retro style shooter with modern visuals. Collect power ups, destroy the enemy ships and defeat the mega bosses in 12 action packed levels. On your own or with a friend in local co-op mode.

games.name: Fun Chess: Deluxe Edition
games.summary: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.

games.name: Fun Chess: Extended Edition
games.summary: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.

games.name: Fun Chess: Premium Edition
games.summary: Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages. This bundle includes the Ghost and Elf DLCs.

games.name: Fun Chess: Ultimate Edition
games.summary: Pick your favorite Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages. Hone your skills

games.name: Fun! Fun! Animal Park
games.summary: Fun for the whole Family! 30 unique mini games feature the intuitive Joy-Con motion controls and the rules are so easy that players of all ages and experience levels will have so much FUN! FUN!

games.name: FunBox Party
games.summary: Fun Box party is a perfect party package, because having fun together is the best kind of fun. Three arcade games that are perfect for making any party the best one ever!

games.name: Funghi Explosion
games.summary: Easy to play alone and fun with a friend, this puzzle game is great for beginner or veteran alike. The rules are simple: gather up three of the same Funghi to make them disappear.

games.name: Funguys Swarm
games.summary: Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire—and it’s very much not fine. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe—just maybe—save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

games.name: Funi Raccoon Game
games.summary: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)

games.name: Funimal: Fusion Animal
games.summary: Funimal is a turn-based sliding puzzle that you can always clear in 5 moves or fewer! The purpose is to move the ground and lead the unknown creature “Funimal” to the goal. Set on a mild planet drawn in pixel art, go to various fields and catch Funimal at your own pace!

games.name: Funko Fusion
games.summary: Funko Fusion is a third-person action game that’s all about celebrating fandom. Play with some of your favorite characters from across TV, movies, games, and comics, and explore handcrafted worlds inspired by Jurassic World, Back to the Future, JAWS, The Thing, Chucky, Battlestar Galactica, Hot Fuzz, The Umbrella Academy, Five Nights at Freddy’s, Masters of the Universe, Invincible, and many more!

games.name: Funny Animal Cafe
games.summary: Run the coziest café in town, staffed and visited by adorable animal friends! In Funny Animal Café, you start small, but with smart choices, tasty menus, and creative decor, your café will become the talk of the town.

games.name: Funny Bunny: Adventures
games.summary: Nice looking and fun game, that develops logical thinking and responsivity. It is highly recommended for children!

games.name: Funny Cats Puzzle
games.summary: A puzzle game featuring slightly clumsy and cute cats is here!

games.name: Funny Farm Animal Jigsaw Puzzle Game for Kids and Toddlers
games.summary: This animal puzzle game has been specially developed for children and includes different levels of difficulty that are freely adjustable. Furthermore, help functions can optionally be switched on, or the rotation for the puzzle pieces can be switched on. As soon as the rotation for the parts has been switched on, the parts can be rotated 90 degrees at a time. The puzzle game contains many great, funny and unique animal motifs suitable for children. Please note that this jigsaw puzzle game only supports touchscreen functionality. The menu and the scenes can only be played with the touch controls!

games.name: Funny Folks Cafe
games.summary: Serve Up Smiles

games.name: Funny Sunny
games.summary: Get ready to shine bright and collect the stars in the whimsical world of 'Funny Sunny' - the ultimate billiards-style game!

games.name: Funny Truck
games.summary: Throw annoying people out of your truck. Collect points.

games.name: Funtasia
games.summary: Funtasia is a paradise polluted by airborne garbage turning it into a landfill. Only a handful of heroes and their goofy machines can help. Push the pedal to the metal, drive as fast as you can, and survive the Furry Road in this unique, sidescrolling racing game for single and co-op players!

games.name: Fur Squadron
games.summary: Fur Squadron is an arcade space shooter on rails, which follows the adventure of a team of elite pilots during what seems at first a routine training in virtual reality.

games.name: Fur Squadron Phoenix
games.summary: Embark on an action-packed adventure in this on-rails space shooter. As a trainee pilot, you will fight in strange virtual worlds. Master your ship, upgrade your skills and protect the federation from an imminent threat. Are you up for the challenge?
games.storyline: War drums are beating at the Bist System. Alarmed by the increasing activity of the dangerous Marauders, the Chimera Federation has decided to reinforce the troops of its space fleet. A brave and determined recruit is sent to the renegade FUR Squadron for special training using their virtual reality technology. Will they manage to hone their skills before it's too late?

games.name: Furi
games.summary: Fight your way free in our frenzied all-boss fighter, and discover what’s waiting behind the last gate. Furi is all about the tension of one-on-one fights against deadly adversaries. It’s an intense, ultra-responsive hack-and-slash with a unique mix of fast-paced sword fighting and dual-stick shooting. Each of the formidable guardians —designed by Afro Samurai creator Takashi Okazaki— has a unique and surprising combat style that requires focus and skill to defeat. The high-energy action gets a boost from an explosive soundtrack composed by electro musicians including Carpenter Brut, who created the trailer’s theme.
games.storyline: A mysterious man known only as The Stranger is held captive and tortured in a highly advanced prison, a chain of ten islands floating above a distant planet. Each island is watched over by a single powerful guardian whose sole purpose is to keep him from escaping. His imprisonment ends when a masked figure called The Voice sets him free, hands him a sword and a gun, and urges him to fight his way out. To win his freedom, The Stranger must face and overcome every guardian standing between him and the world beyond.

games.name: Furious Bikers
games.summary: Tighten up your gloves and warm your engines!

games.name: Furniture Flipper Simulator 2023: Revive, Restoration & Creative Crafting
games.summary: Craft Your Dream Furniture Empire – From Sketch to Reality!

games.name: Furry Girls Paradise: Love & Fun
games.summary: Cute furry girls, playful challenges, and unexpected reactions. Ready to discover who’s waiting behind each victory?

games.name: Furry Hentai Tangram
games.summary: Enjoy a light challenge with beautiful visuals on this relaxing puzzle game full of cute furry girls!

games.name: Furry Pride Paradise Love & Fun
games.summary: Colorful furry boys, playful challenges, and reactions full of personality. Who will you unlock first in this pride filled paradise?

games.name: FurryFury: Smash & Roll
games.summary: A dynamic beast-rolling physics-based online arena brawl.

games.name: Furwind
games.summary: Furwind is a colorful, pixel art style, action-platformer game that evokes the challeging classics of the old days. Embark on this epic adventure in which a little fox will fight the ominous darkness that is invading its world.
games.storyline: The old war between ancestors​ ended with the imprisonment of one of them. Darhûn, who was caged for eras, has been released from his captivity and is ready to take the dark and madness to the forest. ​Furwind, a young inhabitant of Moontail, is not aware that soon will go to one of the biggest and most dangerous adventures of his life.​

games.name: Fury Fight: Gangsters of City
games.summary: Violent crime lords have taken over the city. Defeat them and bring their underlings to justice in an excellent beat 'em up action game.

games.name: Fury Roads Survivor
games.summary: Drive your modded vehicle through a post-apocalyptic wasteland and defend yourself from motorized scavengers who want your fuel and flesh.

games.name: Fury Unleashed
games.summary: Fury Unleashed is an action platformer where you shoot your way through the pages of an ever-changing comic book. Take advantage of unique combo system to unleash your fury and become a whirling tornado of destruction. Discover why your creator doubted you and prove him wrong. Your guns are your best friends, and ink is your most valuable resource – collect it from defeated enemies to permanently upgrade your hero. The more dynamic and brave your play style, the greater the rewards! But remember to stay focused at all times, or you will die sooner than you think and lose everything you looted on your way.
games.storyline: Somehow chaos has entered the comic book multiverse and your whole world has gone nuts. That’s how your story starts: You’re from a long-gone era, and were once a great hero, but now things have gotten worse – your powers have been lost! Your quest is simple, yet deadly – you need to write your story anew and relive your greatest accomplishments. Order will be restored when and only when you prove you are the true Hero.

games.name: Fury Unleashed: Bang Edition
games.summary: Fury Unleashed Bang Edition includes: - Base Game - Special Cover - Hive Queen Boss Key Chain

games.name: Fuser
games.summary: A nonstop virtual music festival where you control the music! Combine elements of the world’s most popular songs to create your own sound or partner with friends on epic collaborations, then share your amazing mixes and headlining performances with the world!

games.name: Fuser: VIP Edition
games.summary: From the creators of Rock Band and Dance Central comes FUSER - a non-stop digital music festival where you control the music! Combine elements of the world’s most popular songs to create your own sound or partner with friends on epic collaborations, then share your amazing mixes and headlining performances with the world! VIP Edition (Digital) includes: - FUSER game - 25 additional launch DLC songs - Gilded Rabbit Helmet - FUSER Fest Outfit - Remix Runner Outfit - Shatterfall Video Wall Pack

games.name: Fusion Paradox
games.summary: Defy the ancient goddess of war and free the Agency from the forces and anomalies that have captured it in this scrolling shooter and action roguelike game

games.name: Fusion Shift
games.summary: Control your enemies and eliminate them as fast as possible.

games.name: Futoshiki Math
games.summary: > 90 puzzles both for beginners and pro's > Beautiful background art > Light and dark color themes Futoshiki Math is played on a square grid. The objective is to place the numbers such that each row and column contains only one of each digit. Some digits may be given at the start. Inequality constraints are initially specified between some of the squares, such that one must be higher or lower than its neighbor. These constraints must be honored in order to complete the puzzle.

games.name: Future Aero Racing S Ultra
games.summary: Enjoy of fast and futuristic arcade races in Future Aero Racing S Ultra. Show who is the best driver along 15 exciting circuits and face off the most adverse weather conditions such as rain, snowstorms and sand tornadoes.

games.name: Future Knight
games.summary: Frenetic action and LCD aesthetic! In this 2D Shoot 'Em Up, switch between a robot hero and his benign tumor to stop a bizarre cult. You have 8 hours to save humanity's memory: defeat grotesque bosses, ride the skies on your Future Board, and master the chaos in a retro-futuristic Tokyo.

games.name: FutureGrind
games.summary: Grab your bike and hit the rails in FutureGrind, a stylish stunt-racer all about tricks, skill, and speed. Use your futuristic motorcycle to do crazy combos on tracks made of floating rails, but be careful: If you touch the wrong rail you'll explode! Only skilled players will earn endorsements from The Sponsors and make a name for themselves.

games.name: Fuuraiki 4
games.summary: In Fuuraiki 4, you can enjoy the scenery from every angle, captured with a 360-degree camera in Gifu Prefecture—the heart of Japan. The series, which will celebrate its 20th anniversary in 2021, has gained popularity as an adventure game in which you travel by motorcycle across beautiful, real-life scenery—and occasionally meet girls along the way. Discover the unseen side of Gifu on a new motorcycle touring adventure.

games.name: Fuuraiki 5
games.summary: The 5th game in the series this time takes place in Mie prefecture.

games.name: Fuyu Kiss
games.summary: Fuyu Kiss is a romance visual novel. In the snowy landscape you give me a first kiss.
games.storyline: Japan was in the midst of a record-setting cold wave. My city - Uetsuruto - was no exception, as we were beset by day after day of freezing weather. Then, one night, I received a text from an unknown number. "Look outside your window! Snow! It's snowing!" Sure enough, the world outside my window had been transformed into a white wonderland. "I'm sorry to text you so late. It's just... You were the first person I wanted to tell." That was the final message they sent me. I had no idea who the sender was. Yet I had the strange feeling that, very soon, I might just fall in love. In a world of snow, a warm and gentle love story is woven.

games.name: Fuyu Kiss: Complete Limited Edition
games.summary: Fuyu Kiss is a romance visual novel. In the snowy landscape you give me a first kiss. The Limited Edition of Fuyu Kiss includes: - Fuyu Kiss - B2 tapestry - PR card
