Then, one night, I received a text from an unknown number. "Look outside your window! Snow! It's snowing!" Sure enough, the world outside my window had been transformed into a white wonderland. "I'm sorry to text you so late. It's just... You were the first person I wanted to tell." That was the final message they sent me. I had no idea who the sender was. Yet I had the strange feeling that, very soon, I might just fall in love. In a world of snow, a warm and gentle love story is woven.

games.name: Fuyukara, Kururu.
games.summary: "Eh? What do you mean that Shihon-chan might die? Eeh? Shihon-chan's head has gone missing?" It seems Shihon-chan's headless body was found in the meditation room. A murder isn't unusual, after all, there's at least one bloodthirsty killer at school. Murdering people is fine and all but it's considered a taboo that must be never violated to decapitate and hide their head because one can never be revived if so. If her head isn't found within two days, she'll really kick the bucket! A boarding system school isolated from the outside world, and there do the immortal girls live. The time it takes for them to become an adult is the same time it takes for them to deage and become a baby, they grow up until they become an adult once more and then do they deage again⁠—a cycle that's being repeated. There's only one condition in order to graduate from school: one needed to be deemed a prodigy by someone observing from the outside. The moment that verdict be handed down, the girl's graduation would be recognized and she would disappear from school. The immortal girls' peaceful school life would be greatly disturbed by a certain murder case.

games.name: Fuyukuru.: Winter winds, adieu?
games.summary: A “denpa” visual novel about a grisly murder in a sealed institution for immortal girls. Wool needle, knitting needle, sewing machine needle. Silk needle, stitching needle, injection needle. Futon needle, clothing needle, hook for a fish. Follow the needles to your immortal death.

games.name: Fuyuzono Sacrifice
games.summary: An otome game by Otomate.

games.name: Fuze Player
games.summary: Hundreds of games have been developed using the award winning Fuze 4 Nintendo Switch coding app. The Fuze Showcase Gallery was created to highlight the best submissions. However as many of these are so good, Fuze decided it was best to make them available beyond the Fuze community. The Fuze Player includes more than 20 games developed by Fuze and the Arena Community. Included Games: - Super Mega Arena Blaster - Fast Food Dizzy for FUZE - Crazy 3D Shooter - Vecroids - Ninja Scroll - Know Your Plaice! - FUZE Bounce - Asteroid Navigator - Genial Chess - Patience Solitaire - Super Laser Blast - Motorway Memory - Missiles - No Escape from Red Hell - Vi-Race - AnimeUltraHyperJump - Da Bean - Shapes Mini Game - Cube Puzzle Toy - Skatey Cat - Parasail Pat - FUZE Fit Adventure 2 … and even more 'Free to Download' titles are being added to the Fuze Showcase Gallery as they become available.

games.name: Fuze4 Nintendo Switch
games.summary: FUZE4 Nintendo Switch is a coding application for Nintendo Switch. It has been designed and developed by a team of experienced gamers, programmers, artists and educators. The end result is a language ideally suited to coding games and apps for absolute beginners and seasoned programmers alike.

games.name: FuzzBall
games.summary: Roll, dash, bash and smash in this playful 4 player brawler! Play as one of 6 FuzzBalls, these small animal plush toys roll into balls of fluff to move around and knock their enemies off a selection of 7 unique stages.

games.name: FX-Unit Yuki: The Henshin Engine
games.summary: Take control of Yuki and set of on a digital journey of pixel proportions! Get Ready for FX-Unit Yuki!!! 8 levels of hardcore retro action with Power-Ups, Varying Stage Types and Multiple Endings accompanied by an Amazing Sound Design.

games.name: FZ: Formation Z
games.summary: A legendary robot shooter classic returns, reborn for modern platforms! Whether you are discovering it for the first time or returning as a long‑time fan, this high‑speed transformation shooter is ready to deliver an electrifying rush like never before.

games.name: G-Darius HD
games.summary: Take flight in the iconic Silver Hawk and immerse yourself in thrilling gameplay with both modern HD-visuals or authentic retro-arcade graphics. Experience the conflicts between the Amnelia Kingdom and the merciless Thiima Empire that took place before the battle between the people of Darius and Belsar. During this conflict, the series’ iconic Silver Hawks were created to make use of the game’s unique capture ball system that allows you to forge your own strategy and gain an edge over the enemy! G-DARIUS HD is the port of “G-DARIUS” in high resolution – developed by the masters of remastering at M2. The game can also be played in low resolution like in the original arcade version. From the epic boss battles to the memorable soundtrack, G-DARIUS stood out when it first got released in the arcades and up to these days, critics and fans are praising this game as a prime example of how to bring a 2D game series properly to 3D.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 01: Flyhight Cloudia
games.summary: A JRPG whose story takes place in the sky! Set in the empty world "Cloudia", an orthodox RPG that emphasizes the scenario. The story begins when Reinas, the knight of the great power, Kaisersult, marches to the neighboring island "Badersen". In the world of Claudia, which controls airships and travels between floating islands scattered in the sea of clouds, a dramatic scenario with a variety of events will be developed. With a unique combat system (multiweight battle) that can be easily operated, it reproduces speed and exhilarating action at the same time. You can enjoy powerful battle scenes with magic and special moves full of effects.
games.storyline: Cloudia, a world in the sky, where floating islands are scattered in the sea of clouds. Reinas, the cavalry platoon leader of the Kaisershult Empire, is ordered by the king and goes to conquer Badelsen Island with his ally Ronald. Reinas and Ronald launch a surprise attack on the command tower of the island. Reinus successfully conquered the command tower, but he was not satisfied with the military's way of slaughtering citizens and confronted with Ronald. Reinas, who was convicted of treason, is chased from the Kaisershult army. The increasing number of mysterious magical beasts, the suspicious rumors of King Kaisersult, and the entrance to a different space. The journey of Reinus, where various fates intersect, begins now...

games.name: G-Mode Archives 02: Ai to Roudou no Hibi
games.summary: Ai to Roudou no Hibi is a surreal mobile life simulation game where the player takes control of a bear as they get a job and live out their short 31 day life. The bears job consists of rolling a ball to a goal, avoiding holes and obstacles. Failing to do so results in some strong words their boss and a cut to their wages.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 03: Kururin Cafe
games.summary: Set in a cafe, this is a cute puzzle game where you rotate the cursor to connect and erase 3 or more blocks of the same pattern. Look at the customer's order, erase the block shown on the menu, and clear the screen as you advance in the different levels. Let's satisfy the customers while aiming for a big chain! There are three modes available: "Kururin mode" where the player must complete orders within the time limit, "Challenge mode" a vs. 2-player mode, and "Tokon mode" to play endlessly without a time limit.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 04: Beach Volleyball Girl Shizuku
games.summary: This two-on-two beach volleyball game has players competing to be the best team possible.The core game is action-based, with a relatively fast pace and special over-the-top super moves for each character. Players can either play in a story mode, where they follow protagonist Shizuku's beach volleyball career, or practice matches against the CPU in a versus mode. A collection mode also lets players dress up the characters in the various swimsuits they've collected.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 05: Sukebooo Man
games.summary: This side-scrolling extreme sports game puts a side-scrolling spin on the skateboarding craze of the 2000s. Players jump their way through 2D platforming levels, complete with bottomless pits and floating platforms, while collecting burgers. Instead of running through like in a traditional platformer, though, they skate their way through. Players can perform various tricks while flying through the air, racking up points by doing tricks and combos. Players compete for high scores on each level, balancing collecting burgers and performing complex series of tricks to maximize their score.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 06: Shijou Saikyou Miyamoto Julia
games.summary: 50 years after the end of the Galactic War, the eastern galaxy's bubble economy finally pops. The resulting depression catapults society into a desperate age of class stratification, with workers at the bottom struggling to make ends meet. Julia Miyamoto, the player character, is a temp worker doing her best to get by in the bad economy. She takes a gig at the Galaxy Crisis Management Organization, where she discovers that she has an incredible talent for cleaning up other people's messes, and sets out to prove herself. In the process, she'll find herself drawn into a galaxy-wide conspiracy. This mission-based action RPG has players setting out to clear missions by wiping out waves of enemies as efficiently as possible.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 07: Love Love Knuckle
games.summary: Love Love Knuckle is a goofy beat-em-up starring buff men wearing animal heads. Players use their buff animal man to beat up other buff animal men and collect the high-calorie sweets they drop to recover health. In between battles, players can buy upgrades to customize their character, including new heads.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 08: Pucchin Puzzle
games.summary: Pucchin Puzzle provides a variation on the nonogram puzzle genre. Players control a square-shaped dog on a grid; players need to mark specific squares in the grid to reveal pixel-art pictures, following hints on the top and left sides of the screen. The game's puzzles are divided into many different themed worlds, laid out on a world map, with different graphical styles and different costumes for the main characters in each different world.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 09: Flyhight Cloudia II
games.summary: Fulfilling a promise made a long time ago, to a faraway place in the sky. The world above the clouds "Cloudia" and the world under the clouds "Eldia". Various thoughts that connect the two worlds begin to spin a new story... In this work, a map display function that helps you capture in the complicated dungeon, a pose function in the event scene, etc. have been added, so that you can enjoy the game more comfortably, and the unique battle system "Mariu" that was popular in the previous work Great upgrade of "Battle" has been greatly upgraded. Attributes (fire/ice/thunder), special skill system, elements of the line separating the vanguard and the rear guard are added, and flashy attack effects using polygons produce powerful battles.
games.storyline: A few months after the defeat of the synthetic demon beast Fuze--- Kaisersult officer Leonard was wandering around the world "Eldia" under the clouds. Leonard, who chases the identity of the mysterious girl Nia in "Eldia", meets a boy, but ... What happened to Ronald, who was supposed to have returned safely? And... what is the fate of Nia and the boy? The light of hope is beyond the sky---

games.name: G-Mode Archives 10: Souhide Series Omatsuri-zukushi
games.summary: Let's go out for various fairs every season! A collection of festival mini-games full of nostalgia! You can enjoy a variety of games such as the festival's classic "goldfish scooping" and "shooting", as well as "smart ball" and "ring throwing" as much as you want. There are games that can be played other than opening stores, such as "Bon Dancing" at the summer festival and "Mochitsuki" at the spring festival. Let's explore every corner of the shrine throughout the year and play all 10 kinds of mini-games. The memories of the player playing are written in a diary. I enjoyed shooting... I ate a lot of yakisoba... Let's write a lot of your own thoughts in your diary.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 11: Senbazuru
games.summary: A horror adventure novel that stimulates the imagination. What do you pray for with a thousand cranes? Senbazuru is generally known to be folded for "prayer". However, it is said that it has the aspect of a kind of obsession and a desperate wish... The main character "Yuichi Sasaki" is an ordinary 26-year-old office worker. One morning, Yuichi receives a call from a hospital called Tsukumo General Hospital, which he had never heard of. It seems that his lover Mayuri was transported the night before. He hurried to Tsukumo General Hospital, but... A scenario where you can't predict what happens next, a branching system with "cards" that determines the future of the story. Let's complete various stories surrounding Yuichi and Mayuri.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 12: Night Hike
games.summary: Night Hike is the second entry in the Senbazuru, or Thousand Paper Cranes, series. In the darkness, an unknown fear attacks you. "Night Hike'' is an outdoor program that increases people's tolerance for darkness, senses they don't normally use, and a sense of solidarity with others by walking on mountain trails at night without lights. Keita Iizuka, a budding reporter, is drawn to the unfamiliar term "night hike" and joins an outdoor tour in a deserted camp on the outskirts of the Tokyo metropolitan area. Scenarios branch through a "choice card" system. An immersive sound production stirs your imagination. In the darkness filled with anxiety and fear, will you be able to welcome the morning again?

games.name: G-Mode Archives 13: Rinji Shuuden
games.summary: The third entry in the Senbazuru series. A strange event that attacks a passenger on a mysterious train... "No... I remember seeing the last train running leaving me behind. After that... That's right... The next train of the last train came into the platform. On the destination panel ... it said "Temporary last train." A few passengers boarded the last train on a certain line at midnight. The scenery wrapped in darkness. A strange unmanned station. Hydrangea flowers that emerge on the night after the rain in early summer. The mysterious atmosphere and the fear of not being able to reach the original world are there... The third game of the Senbazuru series. Can you get through this fear...!?

games.name: G-Mode Archives 14: Mystia
games.summary: In order to save the village crisis, the magical swordsman Meena leaves. An easy-to-play adventure fantasy that everyone wanted. The first installment of the adventure fantasy RPG "mystia" series set on the Mystia continent. Let's operate Meena, a magical swordsman, and go on an adventure while defeating monsters and searching for treasures in the field and dungeons! The combat system is a simple command battle that pursues operability. If you fight with 8 kinds of magical attributes in mind, no matter how strong the opponent is, you may be able to advance the battle to the advantage! It is also equipped with a memo function that shows the next purpose and an auto save function, so you can play on the move with peace of mind. Let's get rid of the many monsters that attack, solve the mystery, and regain the peace of the village.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 15: Chura-jima Kurashi
games.summary: Where there is sky and sea, there is a story. Experience the "slow life" of your dreams on a southern island! It is a game where you can simulate life on the fictional island "Churajima" reminiscent of a remote island in Okinawa. "I want to be wrapped in the pleasant sound of waves and look at the wide sky on the sandy beach ..." Such a longing "slow life" is waiting for you. Interact with village residents and tourists, sea fishing, shamisen, hub extermination, Okinawan cuisine, etc. You are free to enjoy the activities unique to the southern island and do anything. You can walk around the island and have various experiences. Why don't you relax in "Chura Island" with the main character who moved because he was tired of living in the city?

games.name: G-Mode Archives 16: Beach Volleyball Girl Shizuku 2: Hishou-hen
games.summary: Beach fairies fly to the world! Take the victory against the world's powerhouses! The second easy-to-use beach volleyball game in which a cheerful high school girl, Shizuku Asagiri, is active. One year after the previous work, the "Cinderella Cup" that determines the No.1 in the country... Shizuku and his partner Haruna will go on a world expedition and challenge powerful players from various countries. Let's win a hot rally that unfolds with famous places around the world in the background and seize the victory! In addition to unique characters and gorgeous swimsuits, this work introduces a "tanning system"! Depending on the swimsuit you are wearing, you will leave healthy sunburn marks on the water. You can enjoy the combination of swimsuit collection and sunburn marks.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 17: Flyhight Cloudia III
games.summary: The thoughts reflected in the distant sky are the ties that bind a new world... Here and now, all the mysteries will be revealed.
games.storyline: Cloudia closed the cloud hole and peace returned again. The Zards returned to Eldia and embarked on an investigation to uncover the conspiracy of the Thesis Committee. On the other hand, Nia, who was released from demonization, is determined to remain in the sky with Reinas and others, Eldia's superparticle gun "Light of Arneus" was released, and the sky was cut again. The thesis committee and the Eldia government army on an offensive with magical beasts. Cloudia's army, including Reinas, makes a request to each country and gathers a large fleet. What is the true purpose of the thesis committee? What is the secret hidden in Zard's birth? All the mysteries are solved here and now.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 18: Hero Must Die. Director's Cut
games.summary: An innovative RPG produced with Mr. Shoji Masuda for the original draft, scenario, and game design, Shunya Yamashita for character design, and Kenji Ito for music and gorgeous famous creators. The hero who defeated the demon king and saved the world in exchange for his life went on a journey to find the woman he loved with five days of life expectancy. Time in the game passes according to the action, and as death approaches, the hero gradually loses his power... A multi-scenario where you can experience new discoveries and new developments every time you play back. You can enjoy it as many times as you want due to the multi-ending where the content of the funeral changes depending on what you do before you live.
games.storyline: The hero finally defeated the demon king who was trying to destroy the world. But I lost my life at the price... After a while, a miracle happened. With God's guidance, the hero got only five days of life. The awakened hero believed that peace had come to the world. But that's not the case. During the war, people who cooperated and sub-races started skirmishing. Unemployed knights and mercenaries are overflowing in the town. In such confusion, the hero goes on a journey to find his missing lover. The time left for him is only five days, whether he cries or laughs...

games.name: G-Mode Archives 19: Magical Drop DX
games.summary: Take, throw, and connect the colorful drops! An action puzzle with an exhilarating chain of events! "Magical Drop DX" is an action puzzle game in which characters resembling tarot cards take or throw drops and line up three or more vertically to make them disappear. If you line up other drops while a drop is disappearing, you can create a chain and score high points! Run left and right across the field to gain an edge over your rivals! The game includes a "Story Mode" where you can fight against the computer at three different levels (easy, normal, and hard), and a "Hard Mode" where you just keep erasing drops on a larger stage than usual.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 20: Magical Fantasista
games.summary: The first in the series of magical synthetic RPG. In order to avoid the pinch of school withdrawal, Holin, a student of the Magic College, travels on an adventure to clear the challenges in the "Seventh Star System". The "Seventh Star System" that Holin ventures is made of the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, and the Sun, and the inside of the dungeon changes every time you enter. At the bottom, there is a boss waiting to see through the task. Please aim to be a "fantasista" in the magical world by developing various magical effects and skills that Holin herself has hidden, and creating powerful magic freely.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 21: Unou Paradise
games.summary: I'm snoring in my tired right brain! Have fun checking the power of the right brain that controls intuition and inspiration. "Unou Paradise" is a game that fun to play and check the ability of the "right brain" that controls human intuition, inspiration, creativity, and image. All you need for the operation is 4 buttons, up, down, left and right, and your judgment. Check the ability of the "right brain" while doing various tasks (games) such as quickly counting the animals in the group within the time limit and instantly choosing the same picture as the example. There are 8 types of tasks (games) included. There is an "exam" mode through all assignments and a "practice" mode where you can play only one type of assignment.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 22: Heracles no Eikou III - Kamigami no Chinmoku
games.summary: "Glory of Heracles" is an RPG based on Greek mythology. Since the release of the first work "Tojin Makyoden: The Glory of Heracles" in 1987, it is a popular RPG series that has spun stories with a number of hardware, and this work is the best scenario and famous title in the series. The story is independent of other series works, and you can enjoy it alone. In a world where day and night change with the passage of time, the people and shops you can meet will change. While confronting strong enemies while making full use of 7 kinds of characteristic weapons and magic learned in temples in various places, in battles with weak enemies, the characters will fight automatically battle only with striking attacks by switching to auto battle mode, so it's stressful. You can play without it.
games.storyline: Ancient Greece── It is a time when the heavenly world where the gods live and the human world are not so far apart. One day, the main character woke up and had lost all his memories until then. Who am I? Where did you come from? I didn't even remember my name. Instead, he had a mysterious ability that he would not die no matter what height he fell from. And the mysterious dreams I often see... The main character loses his memory just like himself, has an immortal body, meets friends who have the same dream, Each of them will travel together to find out who they are. At the same time, there were unprecedented natural ecassms in various parts of the world. The land that suddenly sinks. Monsters boiling from the hole that leads to the underworld... As the scale of the abnormality was expanding day by day, something was about to happen to the whole world. Immortal friends who have lost their memories. Their past is the key to solving the mystery of natural catastes──.

parent_game.name: Heracles no Eikou III: Kamigami no Chinmoku

games.name: G-Mode Archives 23: Keitai Shoujo
games.summary: "Keitai Shoujo" is a love simulation game with the aim of making a girlfriend in about 40 days until Christmas with Lin, a girl who became a mobile phone girl. As you live your daily school life, let's talk to girls, email and date. At specific events, the PPM (psychedelic pink motion) system that allows you to freely appreciate girls is activated, and the reaction and favorability of girls changes depending on the point of view, and there are also factors such as being reflected in the game. Please enjoy the pure love story with the five girls who appear.
games.storyline: The main character, Hiroshiro Aida, is in the second year of high school. It's almost Christmas, but I can't have a girlfriend this year, so I'm feeling a little immetied. When I'm surfing the Internet on my cell phone to kill time, I found a site called "Gal☆Mo~do" that I was a little curious about and downloaded the standby screen. When the download is over and the "Done" is displayed, when the mobile phone terminal emits intense light, There was a small girl sitting there that was enough to sit on the palm of her hand. "I'm Lin. How about you?" "If you were able to download me, do you have a girlfriend by any chance?" "I'm a little troubled if you can't be happy by Christmas. I don't have time, so I'll explain..." Saying that, Lin tells her that if Aida doesn't make a girlfriend by Christmas, she won't be able to return to the original world. Can you make her by Christmas to become the main character and safely return Lin to her original world?

games.name: G-Mode Archives 24: Sangokushi Nendaiki DX
games.summary: Expand the territory and unify the world at a good pace. A country stealing game that you can easily enjoy in the era of the Three Kingdoms! "Sangokushi Nendaiki DX" is a country stealing simulation game set in the era of the Three Kingdoms in China, and can be enjoyed by a wide range of beginners and advanced users. Let's expand our army's territory while moving units to empty territories and attacking enemy territories, and aim to unify the country with all 5 scenarios. The battle is conducted by roulette, and it is a simple one that "the higher the number wins". The more the force of the unit increases, the larger the number of roulette, and the more the battle becomes dominant. Please command the warlords and reinforcements well and rule the turbulent world with your hands.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 25: Topolon
games.summary: TOPOLON is a futuristic action puzzle game that challenges the nano-world. Viruses have the habit of moving back and forth on wires that are strung across the circuitry. Collide and destroy viruses by attracting and splitting them up. Viruses will continue to be generated indefinitely and, if left unattended, will transform into other forms. The key to clearing a stage is the player's ability to make quick decisions and efficient operations. There are three different game modes, three difficulty levels, and a random stage generation function.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 26: Ore no Sentai Oranger
games.summary: I'll make the next hero! Become the commander of the Hero Squadron and protect the peace on Sunday morning! "Ore no Sentai Oranger" is a training simulation game that nurtures the hero squadron. Each of the five members of the squadron has their own personality, age and gender. In addition to normal physical techniques, I will master "special moves" that make use of my specialty, such as a ike-face attack that shoots the hearts of moms. The growth of the Oranger was confirmed by the battle with the enemy in the Sunday morning program and sales (children's festival). Cultivate a squadron according to the fan base, and compete with other heroes for the popularity ranking and aim for the first place. It's up to you how you enjoy it. Let's grow your favorite squadron!

games.name: G-Mode Archives 27: Ninja no Gakko
games.summary: Train hard to become a full-fledged ninja! A collection of mini games set in a ninja school. Players become students at a three-year ninja school, improve their ninjutsu skills through various mini-game-style classes, and take on promotion exams and graduation exams. You can play 5 types of mini-games, including ``Shuriken Throw'' where you aim at enemies that appear up, down, left and right, and ``Transformation Technique'' where you memorize frog cries in order. As you advance to the next grade, you will be able to take new classes, and the difficulty level of the previous subjects will also increase!! There is no limit to the number of classes you can take, so you can take any subject you like as many times as you like, and there are also elements that allow you to complete your career path after graduating from ninja school.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 28: Sepas Channel
games.summary: If we lose something one by one, The world will fall apart. "Sepas Channel" is an RPG that explores identity. "What is the meaning of your existence to be recognized by others?" " What is freedom and what is time?" A boy who lost his memory, a girl who lost his shadow, and a dog looking for a missing owner. Set in a mysterious world with a sci-fi and fantasy atmosphere, a story surrounding the radio broadcast by the mysterious DJ "Sepaschan" will unfold. If you use the "channel change" system that holds the key to the game, you can switch the characters and groups you operate. Please use the range of action and abilities of the main characters and cooperate with each other to advance the story.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 29: Zanac
games.summary: Zanac is a classic shooting game that made a name for itself in the gaming industry in 1986. This mobile app version of the game recreates the original game, including hidden elements. The game system has been rearranged to make it easier to play. In addition, this title has been improved with the G-Mode archives. The "Arrange" mode allows you to fly through the air more intensely and smoothly. The game includes two modes: "Arrange" mode, which is more intense and smoother, and "Original" mode, where you can enjoy the nostalgic graphics of the time. There are eight types of special weapons. Each weapon has its own unique characteristics, and the power of each weapon increases with successive attacks. The thrill comes from the large number of bullets that the enemy attacks with. Use the special attacks to your advantage to defeat the final boss!

games.name: G-Mode Archives 30: Sorcerian
games.summary: Action RPG "Sorcerian" that gained popularity as a game for PCs and consumers. This work is a complete port of the mobile app version of "Advanced Sorcerian". Redesigned graphics and a variety of effects will enliven your adventure in the fantasy world. Players are free to challenge each scenario by creating a party of 4 people from 4 different classes. Each scenario has a lot of mystery-solving and maze elements, and it's very responsive. Includes "Basic Scenario (Chapter 16)" including tutorials and G-mode original scenarios, and additional scenarios "Sengoku Sorcerian (Chapter 5)" and "Pyramid Sorcerian (Chapter 5)". With the Sorcerians and your hands, lead a number of stories to a happy ending.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 31: Irekae IQ Crossword DX
games.summary: Let's replace the letters and align the words! A new sense of crossword puzzle that makes the pleasure of filling become a habit. If you know the words that enter each square from the vertical and horizontal hints, replace the letters! "Irekae IQ Crossword DX" is a crossword puzzle you play by replacing panels. If multiple words are completed with a single replacement, you will get a high score! In addition, the player's IQ level is judged according to the time required to clear and the score. There are three types of game modes: "World Mode" that clears the stage within the time limit, "IQ Test Mode" that determines the player's IQ level, and "Free Mode" that solves problems without worrying about the time limit. You can participate in each national ranking with your score and IQ index.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 32: Maou Company
games.summary: The matter of hell also depends on the money!? An RPG where the demons of the lower class aim for the heavenly world with the power of money. It is a role-playing game that aims for the heavens with three of his friends, in order to solve the mystery of the item "Pendulum" given to him by his uncle, Loki, a lower-class demon and the main character, is a role-playing game that aims for heaven. If you save money during the adventure, you can exchange "engagement (contract)" with ancient demons with the power of the pendulum. You can acquire a variety of "skills" from the demons who have engaged, so let's acquire "skills" according to your purpose and advance the battle with the enemy advantageously! Also, if you don't understand anything while playing, the explanation will be displayed with one "Navi" button, so beginners in the demon world can also enjoy it with confidence.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 33: Tetris Diamond
games.summary: When talking about feature phone apps, you can never leave out the G-MODE version of "TETRIS". The "TETRIS DIAMOND" version, one of the most popular versions of TETRIS, is back as a G-MODE archive! There are 4 types of game modes included. Starting with the normal "TETRIS mode", "DIAMOND mode" where you can get a bonus score by erasing the line with "Diamond Tetrimino", and "PUZZLE mode" that erases all lines using limited blocks. There are various rules. In addition to familiar techniques such as "TETRISTM line erasing" and "T-SPIN", let's aim for a high score by making full use of the new technique "DIAMOND" using "Diamond Tetrimino"! Please enjoy the glittering world of "TETRIS" that still does not fade.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 34: Majoukko Princess
games.summary: Mefi, the princess of the devil's castle, was defeated by a hero and lost her place. Let's summon our wisdom, trap humans, and recapture the castle! The stage of the story is after the ending of a role-playing game... Mefi, the last boss who has been kicked out of the Devil's Castle, aims to revenge on the hateful heroes! However, there is very little that Mefi, who has lost her magical power, can do. Let's carry the wooden box placed in the stage to make a scaffolding, and make good use of tricks such as Tsurugiyama and punching gloves to clear it. When you get orbs and treasure chests that appear on a specific stage, you can recover your demon friends and stolen treasures, and the title screen that was alone also includes the lively elements that change more and more. Will Mefi be able to regain the demon castle stolen by the hero!?

parent_game.name: Majoukko Princess - Mefi's Great Strategy for Recapturing the Castle-

games.name: G-Mode Archives 35: Magical Fantasista II
games.summary: Lost and in search of "Akashic Records" ... The second magic synthetic RPG that fights by making use of magic and individuality! The second installment of the magical synthetic RPG "Magical Fantasista" series. The three honor students of the Imperial Academy of Magic, Kamui, Mercurius, and Yuturna, were involved in a big incident during the final assignment at the end of the school year and decided to go on an adventure to solve it. The three of them are good at attribute magic, sword magic, and star magic, each of which has different characteristics, and while synthesizing the magic obtained as a trophy and taking an exam at the dojo, while raising the magic level, they face the crisis of the Nebula country. I'll go. Dungeons where the terrain changes every time you enter, and the ability equipment system where you can enjoy a wide variety of training are also alive and well. Enjoy the magnificent world of Magical Fantasista, where many powerful enemies are waiting!

games.name: G-Mode Archives 36: Beach Volleyball Girl Shizuku 3 - Sekai Taikai-hen
games.summary: The shining midsummer sun stimulates the hearts of the fairies. A beach volleyball festival where 16 beautiful girls dance in the air. This game is set in Tokyo in 2XX9, one year after the world expedition in the previous work "Flight Edition". Shizuku Asagiri, the captain of the Ao High School beach volleyball club, was practicing hard every day with his junior, Suzu Kamijima. It was a pair of Shizuku & Bells who challenged the preliminary round of the world tournament for the reunion with Shizuku's best friend Haruna, but ...? In this work, not only new characters, but also nostalgic characters who appeared in past works will participate! In the competition scene, new actions such as "change of operation character" and "combination technique" are also added. In the new "World Tour Mode", you can play in pairs with your favorite characters! Everyone's long-awaited swimsuits and sunburn have also been increased ...! Please enjoy the "Shizuku World" that has evolved more brilliantly and boldly.

parent_game.name: Beach Volleyball Girl Shizuku 3 - Sekai Taikai-hen

games.name: G-Mode Archives 37: Moe Slot Beach no Shizuku
games.summary: Beach fairies appear in the slot! Put out the enchanted "777" with your fingers! "Moe Slot ☆ Beach no Shizuku" is a casino-style authentic slot game that incorporates bonus elements such as "JACK POT" and "FACTOR". During the game, "Shizuku" and "Haruna" of the "Beach Volleyball Girl Shizuku" series will appear, and the adult play will be gorgeous and lovely. A "tutorial" mode that explains the rules in an easy-to-understand manner, which is safe even for beginners, and it can be left alone! Equipped with an "autoplay" function that keeps turning the reels automatically. If you meet certain conditions, the number of "Haruna" costumes will increase, and you can also enjoy dressing up. Please enjoy the pleasure of making opportunities and bonuses solid and grabbing a large amount of coins.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 38: Mystia2
games.summary: The second adventure fantasy drawn with gentle colors. The story of the "King's Sword" left by the god of Mystia. "mystia2" is a fantasy RPG set on the continent of Mystia, one year after the previous work "mystia". In this work, which consists of all three chapters, the party changes for each chapter. A large volume of scenarios around the "King's Sword" left by the gods and the "Masty Stone" that manipulates the gods You can enjoy the world view of "mystia" drawn with gentle colors more deeply. Like the previous work, it is equipped with convenient functions such as a memo function and an automatic save system. There are also plenty of rushing elements such as the treasure collection system and "from the beginning as it is strong" that comes out after clearing. Let's use a wide variety of magic and challenge ourselves to fight against monsters who block our way.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 39: Flyhight Cloudia IV - Eien no Kizuna
games.summary: There is something we must protect with everything we have. We will once again confront the dark clouds of fate that surround us. Flyhight Claodia series is popular as a full-fledged mobile phone RPG. The latest work "Flyhight Cloudia 4" started to happen one after another in the world "Cloudia". It depicts the mystery of mysterious events and the bonds of the people involved in it. This work supports the first "wide screen" function of G-MODE Archives. You can enjoy the adventure of the sky on a powerful large screen instead of a conventional square screen. The combat system adopts multi-weight battles that have been inherited in the series. In addition to enjoying highly strategic battles with easy operation, a convenient "AUTO" mode is also available. You can enjoy fighting with lower-rated enemies without stress and immerse yourself in the story.

parent_game.name: Flyhight Cloudia IV - Eien no Kizuna

games.name: G-Mode Archives 40: Kamura - Kamigami to Chigiri Shisha
games.summary: "Kamura - Kamigami to Chigiri Shisha" is a Japanese-style fantasy RPG that depicts a magnificent story woven by gods and humans on the stage of "The Land of the Sun". The "God Drop" system, which allows you to use unique secret techniques by possessing the gods yourself, and the "Gogyo Aisei and Soko" system, which changes damage depending on the attributes of the gods and the attributes of enemies, etc., produce strategic battles. There are also plenty of collection elements such as completing the picture book by meeting monsters and gods, and there are also dungeons that appear only under specific conditions. In order to stop my brother who fell into darkness, make a contract with the eight million gods in various places and defeat the darkness with the ultimate secret technique!

games.name: G-Mode Archives 41: Izumi Jiken File Vol. 1 - Shiosai-hen
games.summary: The mystery adventure "Izumi Jiken File" series is a mystery adventure game that "deduces the culprit" based on the situation at the crime scene and the information collected by interviewing. The main character, "Izumi Kido", is a female editor in charge of the popular novelist "Kagamitsuki Masamune". After chasing Kagamizuki, who abandoned the manuscript and went on a journey, Izumi arrived in Shonan, the western part of Kanagawa Prefecture. When Izumi finds Kagamizuki and comes on him, Kagamizuki tells with a mysterious face. " Actually, there was a murder case." The victim was a 54-year-old company officer, the scene of the incident was under the breakwater of the port, and the cause of death was a head laceration due to a fall. From the situation at the scene, it looks like an unfortunate accident, but Kagamizuki seems to be convinced that it is a murder. Taizumi, who took the manuscript, went to the city of Shonan to unravel the truth of the incident.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 42: Izumi Jiken File Vol. 2 - Tasogare-hen
games.summary: Suspicious death under the cold sky. Is this a suicide, or... The second installment of the full-scale mystery adventure series. The mystery adventure "Izumi Jiken File" series is a mystery adventure game that "deduces the culprit" based on the situation at the crime scene and the information collected by interviewing. The best-selling author "Kagamizuki Masamune" who always goes on a sudden trip, and the new editor "Izumi Kido" who is in charge of it. Solving the mystery of the code left by Kagamizuki, this time Izumi arrived at Tempozan in Osaka in winter. But there was another incident there... A man who drank coffee with sleeping pills and froze to death leaving a suicide note under the cold sky with a temperature of -5℃. Just before the estimated time of death, she was suddenly told a breakup story from her who was dating, and there is a motive that led to suicide, but Kagamizuki feels uncomfortable with the victim who is said to have moved to the scene of the discovery of the body without wearing a jacket. Izumi, who took the manuscript hostage again this time, is stubborn as an editor and approaches the truth of the case.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 43: Izumi Jiken File Vol. 3 - Yujuku-hen
games.summary: Novelist Kagamizuki Masamune was suspected of a murder case while traveling... The third installment of the full-scale mystery adventure series. The mystery adventure "Izumi Jiken File" series is a mystery adventure game that "deduces the culprit" based on the situation at the crime scene and the information collected by interviewing. The best-selling author "Kagamizuki Masamune" who always goes on a sudden trip, and the new editor "Izumi Kido" who is in charge of it. Three days before the deadline for the new manuscript, Izumi, who is heading to Kagamizuki's apartment, receives an email. "It's become a big deal. I want you to help me. Please come to Kirishimayama Ryokan in Kagoshima as soon as possible." A hot spring inn wrapped in the fresh greenery of Mt. Kirishima. There was a figure of Kagamizuki who was suspected of murder... In the open-air bath where there was a murder case, there are employees at the entrance and "Yoshizu" around it, so it is impossible to commit the crime from the outside. It seems that the five men who used the open-air bath were forced to wait at the inn as suspects of the incident. At this rate, my name as a novelist will be scratched. In order to clear Kagamizuki's suspicion, Izumi challenges to solve the case.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 44: Dragon x Dragon
games.summary: Training × blending × combat. Explore the field and raise the strongest dragon! "DRAGON x DRAGON" is an RPG that captures with three elements: training, blending, and combat. In order to defeat the dark dragon "Genesis" that plunged the world into chaos, the boy "Willow", a descendant of the dragon messenger, grows up with his partner dragon "Kermes". Choose your favorite field from among the many exploration destinations and set off on an adventure. The items that can be acquired depending on the field and the attributes of the wild dragon you live in are different, so let's go deep into the field while consulting with the remaining physical strength of "Kermes" and the items you have on hand. The young "Kermes" returns to "1" every time you return from the search destination, but you can strengthen your basic ability by mixing the items you got in the middle of the search and giving them to "Kermes". The effect varies depending on the material to be blended. Try a wide variety of combinations and raise them to be the strongest dragon.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 45: Chura-umi Monogatari
games.summary: A time of peace spun by the gentle sea breeze. An Okinawa life experience for those who are tired of modern times. Chura-umi Monogatari" is a sequel to the game "Chura-jima Kurashi" that simulates life on the southern island. The stage of this work is a small island "Kotsubu Island" floating in the beautiful sea. The main character, who is tired of living in the city, decided to move after seeing an article on "Recruitment of Administrators of Kotsubu Island" on the Internet. You will spend a five-day trial period on this island where calm time flows. Please enjoy your own southern island life.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 46: Keitai Shoujo: Koi+Hime - Koi ni Ochita Cinderella-hime

In the bag I was holding, there were dolls and glass shoes... The main character with glass shoes is attacked by a "masked man" on the way and escapes from his life, and meets a girl. In the house where she lives, there are girls with familiar faces... "Mobile Phone Girl - Love + Princess - Princess Cinderella Who Fell in Love" is a love simulation "Mobile Phone Girl" Gaiden work. Among the heroines, the story revolves around "Sayo Tomoe" which has a quiet and mysterious atmosphere. The main character "Hiro Aida" is attracted to her and gets involved in a certain incident. When I was attracted to that beautiful form and picked up the flute, a female student who was the owner of the flute appeared at the wrong time, and I was misunderstood ... A female student ... Encounter with "Sayo Tomoe". All stories start from there.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 47: 12Gems
games.summary: The time left is only one night. Save the world with the power hidden in 12 types of GEM. "12GEMs" is an RPG that uses the power hidden in 12 types of GEMs (jewels) and travels while summoning partners sealed in each GEM. The beginning of the story is the aerial castle "Ganseld" floating in the sky with the power of GEM. The people living in Ganseld chose themselves as noble people, and the lower world on earth was taught as a place where unclean people and horrible monsters wandered around, and they lived without involvement. However, one day, the GEM that supported Ganseld suddenly scattered to the uncurled ground. In order to prevent the castle from falling, the main character, the boy "Dino", received the order of collecting GEM and went to the lower world, but it was a mysterious and mysterious world that was different from what was taught in Ganzeldo ... Until Ganzeld crashed, there was only one night left. The fate of the world was entrusted to a boy.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 48: Dragon x Dragon 2
games.summary: What is human charm? What is the truth contained in the holy flower pure bloom... 20 years after the story of DRAGON x DRAGON (Dragon x Dragon). "Seika Pure Brom" has been blooming all over the world since some time ago. The scent emitted from the petals heals people's troubles, seals the darkness that falls into the heart, and silence, innocence and "complete peace" come. The Dark Dragon Genesis, which has reached its end, says, "In order to return to its original form, people must be released from Pure Brom someday." The daughter of Willow, the main character of the previous work, "Adeku", embarks on a new adventure with the young dragon Lily. Not only the characters from the previous work, but also the addition of new characters and enemy dragons has further increased the hit-in element. Also, in this work, you can take over the level after returning from the dungeon, making it easier to play. Adventure with the dragon and solve the mystery that sleeps in the ruins.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 49: Gregory Horror Show
games.summary: Use the abilities of the terrifyingly cute guests, Escape from the mysterious "Gregory House" hotel... "Gregory Horror Show" is based on the popular 3DCG horror comedy broadcasted by CS Broadcasting (Kids Station), etc. It is a horror adventure game that was once produced and distributed for feature phones. There are also many mini-games with unique characters in the game. The ending changes depending on the player's choice and behavior. In addition, the stage of the bonus game after clearing will increase, so you can enjoy it again and again. Please enjoy the hotel life that unfolds with a little scary but cute characters ...

games.name: G-Mode Archives 50: Midnight Horror School
games.summary: Can you save the school from a crisis with your mysterious powers? Mystery-solving adventure set in a school at midnight. "Midnight Horror School" is an adventure game that was once produced and distributed for feature phones based on 3DCG anime works broadcasted in CS, etc. "Midnight Horror School" where ghosts born from forgotten tools can take classes to create "wonders" that prove their existence. The player operates the ghost boy "Hickey" of the red and blue pencil, chooses two people from his friends according to the situation, organizes a party, and solves the mystery that happens at school. games.name: G-Mode Archives 51: Trio the Punch
games.summary: "Trio the Punch" is an arcade action game released by Data East in 1990. If you defeat the enemies in the stage and get a heart, and defeat the boss who appears by collecting all the hearts, you will clear the stage. Of course, "Mr. Chin's roulette corner" is also alive and well. If you draw a hit, you can benefit from increasing your HP and increasing your attack power, so let's push your eyes so that you can get a more effective bonus.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 52: Burger Time
games.summary: Drop it, swing it, and shake the pepper! The main character Peter Pepper is working hard to make hamburgers!! "Burger Time" is an arcade game released by Data East in 1982. This work was remade for feature phones in 2006. Pass over the ingredients, drop them down, and complete all the hamburgers to clear the stage! Avoid wieners and pickles that interfere with the completion of hamburgers by dropping them with the ingredients or interfering them. If you use pepper, you can temporarily stop. Also, if you complete a new hamburger during the game, it will be added to the menu list. Make various kinds of hamburgers, complete the menu list, and aim to clear all with a high score.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 53: Daienkai Buchou
games.summary: Aim to be the biggest banquet manager in Japan!! Let's liven up the banquet with partitions and care! "Daienkai Buchou" is a collection of mini-games based on the motif of Japanese salaryman culture "Banquet". Let's play unique and varied mini-games to liven up various banquets such as year-end parties, New Year's parties, cherry blossom viewing, barbecues, etc., and improve the skills of the secretary! In addition to "Drinkers" who pour beer into the mug, "Sashi-turning" to help with entertainment, etc., all 9 types of mini-games full of seasonal feeling such as "Cherry Blossom Viewing", "Nagashi Somen" and "Fireworks Festival". Also, let's collect bingo prizes with bingo tickets that you can get when you get a high score. Depending on the degree of collection of prizes and the score of the game, the title of banquet manager will be increased! Please aim for the ultimate title!

games.name: G-Mode Archives 56: Mystia3
games.summary: The culmination of the Mystia saga, Mystia 3 acts as a prequel to the previous two games and explores the backstory of the King's Sword artifact at the centre of Mystia 2's plot. It follows Vimal and Gauri, the parents of Mystia's Mina, who are asked by the king of North Mystia to retrieve the King's Sword and use it to defeat the Demon King who threatens all of Mystia. Their story unfolds over the course of five chapters in a journey much longer than the previous two games. This entry features significantly enhanced systems compared to previous games in the series, with a new vertically-scrolling battlefield that spans both the land and the sky. The new game plus feature from the previous game returns as well, offering players new opportunities to try things after completing the game once. This game also introduces detailed event graphics in key story scenes.

games.name: G-Mode Archives 58: Gekidan Musume Akane & Aoi
games.summary: This compilation contains ports of two separate mobile games: Gekidan Musume: Akane and Gekidan Musume: Aoi. Both games are overhead sci-fi shooters with 3D graphics in which players shoot through a series of stages; those stages and enemies are shared between the two games, while each features a different playable character and a different storyline.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Armored Core Mobile 2
games.summary: Build it. Master it. Win with pure will. Forge the ultimate ARMORED CORE with your own hands. ARMORED CORE MOBILE 2 is a port of the classic title originally released in 2005 for feature phones, part of FromSoftware acclaimed 3D mech action series, ARMORED CORE.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Armored Core Mobile 3

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Burari Sekai Untei
games.summary: Because there is untei! Travel around the world on an endless ride. "Burari Sekai Untei" is an endless one-touch action game where you simply advance through the untei surrounding the earth. The basic operation is just to press the button and move forward. However, on the way, the Untei's bar may come off, or someone walking on it may step on it, so hold down the button to extend your arm, and use the 1st and 2nd jumps to avoid it. As the stage progresses, the scenery changes and the screen scrolling speed increases. My first goal is to circumnavigate the globe. However, you can continue the Untei journey even after completing it until you make a mistake. Let's challenge the limits of our physical strength to see how many times we can go around the earth!

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: City Connection Rocket
games.summary: Agent Clarice, step on the accelerator! In order to protect the peace of the earth, fly to the world with your favorite car! City Connection Rocket, which was previously released for feature phones, is a legitimate sequel to the City Connection series, one of Jaleco's signature works. Clarice, an agent dispatched from the United Nations, boards the new Clariscar and goes on a mission to recover the super-secret documents stolen by the runaway secret society "Spiritus". Let's find the super-classified documents hidden on the stage while handling enemy characters well by making full use of the series's annual "oil cans" and "super rockets" that can destroy the road with your body. There are also many huge bosses such as tanks and battle helicopters, and hidden characters with Jaleco fans. Also pay attention to the cute Clarice that is displayed when the stage is cleared!

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Danmaku Kentei Shiken - DaiOuJou-hen
games.summary: Dear Danmaku believers, it's time for a deadly trial. Prove your strength in front of your ever-growing opponent. Cave's shooting games are all about danmaku. But how good am I really? A work that answers that question has finally appeared. This work, "Danmaku Kentai Shikan" is a shooting game that diagnoses your ability to respond to barrage by continuing to fight against opponents who become stronger each time you defeat them. In this work, which is called ``DaiOuJou-hen'', the brutal bosses of ``DoDonPachi DaiOuJou'' will block your challenge. In addition to the in-game class evaluation, this game also supports online rankings, so you can further hone your skills by competing with users from all over the world. Those who are not afraid of death, aim for the top of the barrage.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Danmaku Kentei Shiken - Ketsui-Hen
games.summary: Part of CAVE's line of mobile bullet dodging tests. Released for DoJa and J2ME mobile devices, then re-released for Nintendo Switch. Based on the arcade game Ketsui: Kizuna Jigoku Tachi, it weaves the stages and bosses from the original into an endless boss rush. The farther a player gets, the harder the game becomes. Players are challenged to survive as long as possible while racking up a high score. Players are able to pick from the original game's ships. When you think of CAVE's shooting games, you think of "danmaku". But how good are you really? The second installment of "Danmaku Certification Death Test" will answer that question. This "Danmaku Certification Death Test" is a shooting game that assesses your ability to deal with danmaku by fighting opponents that get stronger with each defeat. In this latest installment, "Ketsui Edition", the vicious weapons from "Ketsui: Kizuna Jogoku Tachi" will stand in your way. In addition to being evaluated by rank in the game, this game also supports online rankings, so you can further hone your skills by competing with users from all over the world. Those heading to hell on earth, behold the essence of danmaku.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: DoDonPachi DaiOuJou DX
games.summary: “It's better to die.” Confirm it with your own eyes. The most deadly barrage in history spreads in the palm of your hand. "DoDonPachi DaiOuJou" is a vertical scrolling shooting game released in 2002. The game's addictive game system, detailed worldview, and challenging difficulty level have won the support of many users. ``DoDonPachi DaiOuJou DX'', which is being reprinted as an archive this time, is a feature phone ported version of the same work. Not only can you take on a barrage of threats, as the title suggests, ``Great Death'', but you can also compete with users from all over the world for your score, thanks to online ranking support. There are also plenty of elements that allow you to change your play style according to your skill and preference, such as changing the difficulty level, selecting your own aircraft type, and selecting an enhanced type (element doll). For both shooting game beginners and bullet hell experts. Challenge the line of death and charm the way of death.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Flash Motor Karen
games.summary: Flash Motor Karen is an action puzzle game in the style of Sokoban. While puzzles are the core of the gameplay, it also features an excellent story. A cool world setting, a wonderful narrative, and unique characters define its charm.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai - Milky no Yabou

With no progress being made, the United Nations abandoned negotiations and secretly decided to intervene with force. The mission is to ``destroy EI's weapons and development facilities'' and ``destroy everything related to UN military intervention.'' Even if the operation is successful, they will not be allowed to return home alive. There were four young people who volunteered for this harsh special mission. Select an aircraft from two types of teams: TYPE-A (WAY SHOT type) and TYPE-B (LINEAR SHOT type). Normal bullets, lock shots, and bombs. Make full use of 3 types of attack methods and overwhelm the hell of barrage and weapons. Also supports online rankings for each difficulty level. After being repaired by Yuri, a girl who lives in the slums, Asura decides to enter "Strike Gigants", Tatsuminato City’s greatest form of entertainment: a robot battle royale. All so that Yuri may attain the happiness she longs for.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Megami Tensei Gaiden - Shinyaku Last Bible III - Mugen no Eiyuu
games.summary: Gather round, demons. Awaken, heroes. A tale of strange evil passed down from generation to generation on the frontier planet of Damir. In addition to the series' customary "Nakama System" in which players negotiate with demonic beasts that stand in their way as enemies and, if successful, are lent power, this title also features the "Obedience Attack," in which defeated demonic beasts recognize your power and become your befrienders, enabling you to collect befrienders more efficiently. Together with your unique friends and fellow travelers, you will unravel the truth of the history passed down to you on the planet Damir.

People were exhausted by the repeated attacks of the monsters and beasts, and everyone kept looking for a brave man who would save the world. ...... One day, the hero accidentally wears a mysterious bracelet called "COMP" which attracts magical beasts. The protagonist sets out on a journey to discover the true identity of "COMP". And to face his own destiny, he sets off on a journey into the vast world.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Mikuni Field Combat
games.summary: Near-future weapons hit the world of the Three Kingdoms! Capture famous heroes and great heroes and invade the world of war! Released for feature phones in 2007, "Mikuni Field Combat" is a spin-off of Jaleco's shooter game "Field Combat," released for arcades and the Family Computer in 1985. "Field Combat" is a strategic shooter game in which you control the futuristic UFO-type attack aircraft carrier "Genesis-3" and capture enemy units with a capture beam to use them as allies while trying to clear stages. For some reason, this futuristic weapon, the "Genesis-3," is storming into the world of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" at the end of the 2nd century! The system of capturing enemies with a capture beam and using them as allies remains the same, but more than 130 popular generals familiar to fans of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms appear! Recruit your favorite generals to your side and survive the wars of mainland China, where intrigue is rife! Operate the futuristic UFO-type attack aircraft carrier "Genesis-3", defeat enemy infantry and obstacles, recruit your favorite generals as your allies, and aim to conquer the stage! Can you survive the wars of mainland China, where political intrigue is swirling? Capture enemy generals and make them your allies. Use the capture beam to capture enemies and make them your allies! More than 130 popular generals familiar to fans of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms appear! Use your allies' unique strategies to gain an advantage in battle! Each captured general has a strategy (special move) that will help you. Figure out when to use it and advance the battle more advantageously! Operate the attack mobile aircraft carrier Genesis-3 to occupy the enemy castle at the top of the map. Damage the boss enemy, who is always present on each side, and defeat, capture, or force them to retreat, and the castle gate will open. Enter the castle gate that Genesis-3 opens to proceed to the next stage. Also, if you damage famous generals, including boss enemies, and weaken their remaining vitality to 30%, a "GET!" message will appear above them, and you will be able to capture them with a capture beam. You can make captured generals your allies after clearing the stage. Capture all the strong enemies and make them your allies to create your own strongest army (you can have up to 14 generals). If your ship, Genesis-3, loses its vitality or the time limit runs out, it will be destroyed and the game will be over. Allied generals who are incapacitated in battles on each stage will not be lost, and will be revived in the next stage or when you continue. All allied generals always have one "strategy." A strategy is a powerful technique that can only be activated once per stage. When the strategy you want to use is lit up in the bottom right of the screen, press the strategy button at the right time to change the course of the battle. Only one strategy can be active at a time, and when a new strategy is activated, the previous one will be overwritten. Continuous strategies last for about 30 seconds, and damage-dealing strategies have the following expected damage value: Water Strategy > Fire Strategy > Ambush Strategy. Each general has a rarity, and is ranked in the following order: GR (Greater Rare) > R (Rare) > S (Special) > N (Normal). The higher the rarity of a general, the less likely they are to appear randomly (as a general excluding bosses), but you can expect a higher level of ability.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Momoko 1200%

Use light-hearted action to tear and throw the Martians who have come to invade Earth! Tear and throw! Aim for the exit somewhere in the field! Clear the stage by entering the exit or defeating a certain number of enemies! As the game progresses, Momoko will grow into a "15-year-old (high school student)" or "18-year-old (working adult)". Depending on how you behave in the game, the schools and occupations you can go to, and even the special moves you can use will change. What kind of appearance will your Momoko show you? Pay attention to the Mars Prince's preferred type. The closer you get to the type, the more heated the final battle will be, and the greater the bonus score upon clearing. The type changes each time you play, so you can play under various conditions. Use special moves to destroy obstacles. Attack not only enemies but also walls and lockers to gain an advantage in the game! By destroying walls and lockers, you may be able to find a shortcut to the exit or items necessary for Momoko's growth. Momoko grows according to how you play. Let's grow Momoko by adjusting the number of enemies defeated, the number of items acquired, etc. If you defeat too much or acquire too much, you may become an unintended type...

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Monstre Waltz
games.summary: Monstre Waltz is an action RPG inspired by the Cthulhu Mythos. Professor Norman Atkins, a magician and former explorer of otherworldly realms, fights using arcane magic. Can he command circular magic and perform a waltz against unnamable monstrosities? Together with a delicate girl who holds the key to the tale, he challenges the sealed labyrinth.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Namco Chronicle

The game was released on Japanese mobile phones on January 22nd, 2007 and recently on Steam & Nintendo Switch 1&2 thanks to G-Mode+ Archives. Releasing on the Switch Platforms on November 20th, 2025 & Steam on December 4th, 2025. The game has Japanese text only.
games.storyline: The game is a spinoff of Stella Deus: The Gate of Eternity, the setting is unclear whether it takes place before, during, or after the original game., There are 2 games that work as a part 1 and part 2. Stella Deus: The Spirit of Darkness / The Black Spirit being part 1, and Stella Deus: The Age of Alchemy being part 2. The story begins after the previous title, "The Spirit of Darkness," and this title also features an entirely original scenario. While connected to the original "Stella Deus" and its predecessor, "The Spirit of Darkness," it is a standalone story that is enjoyable whether you continue playing from the previous title or play this title alone. While the previous title, "The Spirit of Darkness," was easy enough for first-time players, this title is challenging enough for even hardcore players. A new story spanning 50 stages begins in the familiar "Cave of Ordeals" from the previous title.

games.summary: Face the trials and fight through! Team up with unique companions! This is our story — a journey of uncertainty, but we keep moving forward.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 1 - Kamen Gensou Satsujin Jiken
games.summary: Online RPG "Takrimakus" that dies when you play. Uncover the secret hidden in the game, the truth. Hello, everyone. My name is Ikurumi, a game scenario writer. This is the first mobile phone game series that introduces the activities of my friend detective "Ryosuke Kibukawa". This incident started with an investigation of a rumor of an online game that you will die if you play it. At first, I thought it was a simple request, but really one after another... Choose an action (command) and enjoy the many mysteries woven by complex human patterns.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 2 - Kairoukan Satsujin Jiken
games.summary: The "Kailoukan", a strange building surrounded by the sea on all sides. Inside a mansion closed underwater, the curtain rises on a tragedy. Hello, everyone. My name is Ikurumi, a game scenario writer. Do you know the previous work "Masked Fantasy Murder Case"? This time, I would like to introduce an incident that happened in a strange building called "Kairokan" six months after that incident. It is said that it was built by the former chairman of a famous architectural company as a stranger. This story begins from the place where we are invited to the inauguration event of the mansion. 7 invited guests who visited. The owner of the mansion who will not appear forever. And... A tragedy that happens in a mansion closed in the sea. Who is the culprit? What's the motive? And what is the secret hidden in this building? The truth is, in the dark sea...

parent_game.name: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan: Vol. 2 - Kairoukan Satsujin Jiken

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 3 - Shisha no Rakuen
games.summary: Shangri-La, an amusement park named after an ideal world In a paradise overflowing with smiles, a banquet in the name of judgment begins. A few months have passed since the nightmare of the previous work, "The Kairoukan Murder Case." Running out of material, Ikuo visits his friend, Kibukawa. When he returns to the office for the first time in a while, he is approached by Haruna Kikukawa, a beautiful secretary working at the much talked about amusement park, "Shangri-La." The request is to provide security and investigate the cult-like threatening letters and creepy pranks that have been sent to the amusement park. However, the president, Hiroshi Kimijima, asks that the matter be handled confidentially and without telling the police. Though harboring doubts, Ikuo and Izuna decide to head to "Shangri-La." An invitation from paradise brought by the beautiful secretary. A banquet called "judgment" begins from there. Are the cheers echoing through the amusement park, named after a utopia, shouts of joy? Or...?

parent_game.name: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan: Vol. 3 - Shisha no Rakuen

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 4 - Shirasagi ni Aka no Hane
games.summary: This year, red leaves are dancing in the hearts of the white herons left behind. The story of assistant detective Shirasagisu Itsuna and her unknown past. “I… where was I trying to go? ” This story begins with the protagonist, who has lost her memory, waking up in a mountain forest filled with autumn leaves. The protagonist is rescued by a high school girl who calls herself ``Taihouin Izuna'' and learns that this is Momoshiro Village, a small village deep in the mountains of A Prefecture. Who am I? Why did you come to such a remote village? Why did I lose my memory? As the protagonist works with Ituna to unravel her memories, she becomes embroiled in the inheritance issues swirling around the village. This is a sad and heartbreaking incident that leads her to pursue her career as a detective. In this work, you can enjoy the first and second parts of "Crimson Feathers on the White Heron".

parent_game.name: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan: Vol. 4 - Shirasagi ni Aka no Hane

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 5 - Kurai Hako no Ue
games.summary: ``What's on top of this...? ” A creepy urban legend turns into a nightmare that erodes reality. "Late at night, when you call for an elevator on the first floor of a haunted apartment, a ``hako'' slowly descends from the rooftop, which is supposed to be off-limits . When the elevator reaches the first floor and opens its mouth, the entire interior is dyed in bright red..." A friend of game scenario writer Masao Ikurumi, a freelance writer who makes a living writing articles on the occult. Mirokuin Renji heads to the apartment building where the urban legend ``Red Elevator'' is believed to have originated. A strange house full of empty rooms, residents who keep their mouths shut, and the ``incident from eight years ago'' that is said to be cursed if you speak about it. Mirokuin, who pursues the truth hidden in urban legends, confronts his fear that night.

parent_game.name: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan: Vol. 5 - Kurai Hako no Ue

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 6 - Tsuikou Saku Jiken
games.summary: Serial murder case x female secretary disappearance case. Uncover the hidden truth from two intertwined perspectives. A series of murders have been occurring mainly in Marihamadai since last year. Detective Otonari, who is concerned that the victims have no connection with each other and that there is no clue to solving the case, asks his assistant detective Sagishima Izuna to join the police in their investigation. Meanwhile, scriptwriter Ikuo Masao, who is almost forced to take on work for the detective agency, receives a request from a certain company to search for someone. The woman who is the subject of the investigation, Hamakawa Yumiko, is a contract employee working in the secretarial department. After working for a month, she suddenly becomes unreachable... Izuna and Ikuo. The two encounter two cases. What is the truth that awaits them at the end?

parent_game.name: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan: Vol. 6 - Tsuikou Saku Jiken

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 7 - Otonari Keiji no Sousa Memo
games.summary: A lost Chihuahua and a kind town police officer. With their ideal image of a detective in their hearts, this mismatched duo races through the city! A small police box at the crossroads in front of the station, the police station in front of Marihamadai Station. A lost puppy was entrusted to Officer Otonari, who was still working at the police box as a police officer at that time. The dog breed is Chihuahua. According to the attached collar, the name is Chappie. Officer Otonari, tasked with searching for the owner of Chappie, got an eyewitness testimony that a person who seemed to be the owner entered the Marihama Grand Hotel as a result of the interview in front of the station. As long as you know where you are, the solution is near. The man and the dog began their investigation in the hotel lobby, but when a guest came running in with a pale face, they were drawn into further incidents... Otonari Koichi, 26, is always by your side in heart. To protect the peace of Marihamadai, he runs through the town with his little partner!

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 8 - Kamen Genei Satsujin Jiken
games.summary: This is a Switch port of the mobile port of the DS remaster of the first game in the Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan series. Embraced by illusions, I put on a mask... A mysterious serial murder case intertwines with the virtual world and the real world. In April 2003, 8 months after the first work in the series, "Masque Fantasy Incident," Masao Ikuo, the scenario writer for this game, received an invitation to the beta test for the new network game ``Misty Online.'' ``Misty Online'' was Japan's first MMOADV, and it was an unprecedented game in which players and their friends solve incidents that occur in a world that closely resembles a real city. A response from a player playing the role of a corpse who participated in a beta test with Izuna Sagishima of the Igawa Detective Agency and tried to solve a fictional murder case, butdied after falling from a height. Gone... Reality and fantasy. present and past. The countless threads intertwined in a complex and mysterious manner create illusions that envelop people's hearts.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-tan Vol. 9 - Samidare ha Nibiiro no Shirabe
games.summary: I follow his shadow in the pale dull sky.... Eight years ago, the Kibukawa Detective Agency, another great detective.
games.storyline: ...It's been raining for days. In the rainy season of Marihamadai, which was hit by the heavy rain for the first time in 8 years, in the dull rain pattern spreading as if taking away the color of the city, One client visited the "Kibukawa Detective Office". "This is the Kibukawa detective agency, isn't it?" "...Um, I think there was a detective assistant named Sagishima here..." "No, no, it wasn't a daughter like you... was there, wasn't there? A young man called Shirasagisu..." The client says that he came to fulfill the "promise of 8 years ago" to a young man named Shirasagisu, who was once at the detective agency. While the heavy rain is hitting the window, the current detective assistant, Itsuna Shirasagisu, starts listening to the request to take over the request. A story about an incident 8 years ago that was taken on by a young man who used to work at a detective agency shoulder to shoulder with Ryousuke Kibukawa.
